lc-1.takeawayZh: 「找另一半」的问题：边扫边查补数。先查再插入，同一个元素就不会和自己配对。
lc-1.takeawayEn: For "find the other half" problems, look up the complement while scanning. Look up before inserting, so no element pairs with itself.

followUps.qZh: 如果数组已经排好序？
followUps.qEn: What if the array is sorted?
followUps.aZh: 左右双指针：和小了左指针右移，和大了右指针左移，O(n) 时间、O(1) 空间。
followUps.aEn: Two pointers from both ends: move left when the sum is too small, right when too large. O(n) time, O(1) space.

followUps.qZh: 要返回所有和为 target 的数对（按值去重）？
followUps.qEn: Return every pair summing to target, without duplicate values?
followUps.aZh: 排序后双指针，找到一对后两边都跳过相同的值。用哈希表也行，但 x 和 target − x 相等时要求 x 至少出现两次。
followUps.aEn: Sort and use two pointers, skipping equal values on both sides after each hit. A hash map also works, but when x equals target − x it needs at least two copies of x.

followUps.qZh: 三个数的和呢？
followUps.qEn: And three numbers?
followUps.aZh: 排序后固定第一个数，在它右边做双指针，O(n²)，同时跳过重复值。
followUps.aEn: Sort, fix the first number and run two pointers to its right: O(n²), skipping repeated values.

lc-3.takeawayZh: 可变滑动窗口：右端一直前进，窗口不合法时收缩左端；左端单调不回退，总共 O(n)。
lc-3.takeawayEn: Variable sliding window: the right end always advances, the left end shrinks when the window breaks, and it never moves back, so O(n) total.

followUps.qZh: 改成最多包含 k 种不同字符的最长子串？
followUps.qEn: Longest substring with at most k distinct characters?
followUps.aZh: 窗口里用计数表记录每个字符的次数；种类数超过 k 时收缩左端，直到某个字符的次数降到 0。
followUps.aEn: Count characters in the window; when there are more than k kinds, shrink from the left until some count drops to 0.

followUps.qZh: 为什么左端只能往右，不能跳回去？
followUps.qEn: Why may the left end only move right?
followUps.aZh: 用「上次出现的位置」跳左端时要取 max(left, last[c] + 1)。上次出现可能已经在窗口外：比如 "abba" 读到最后的 a 时，a 的上次位置 0 在窗口左边，不能把左端拉回去。
followUps.aEn: When jumping with the last-seen index, take max(left, last[c] + 1). The last occurrence may already be outside the window: in "abba", the final a was last seen at 0, left of the window, and must not pull the left end back.

lc-8.takeawayZh: 解析题先把阶段列出来，每个阶段只做一件事；溢出要在乘 10 之前判断。
lc-8.takeawayEn: For parsing, list the phases first, one job each; check overflow before multiplying by 10.

followUps.qZh: 不允许用 64 位整数时，怎么判断溢出？
followUps.qEn: How do you detect overflow without 64-bit integers?
followUps.aZh: 在乘 10 之前比较：若 result > (INT_MAX − d) / 10，再加这一位就会溢出，按符号直接返回 INT_MAX 或 INT_MIN。
followUps.aEn: Compare before multiplying: if result > (INT_MAX − d) / 10, appending digit d overflows, so return INT_MAX or INT_MIN by sign.

followUps.qZh: 这类规则题怎么写清楚？
followUps.qEn: How do you keep rule-heavy parsing clean?
followUps.aZh: 按阶段写：跳过空格 → 读符号 → 读数字 → 遇到非数字就停。每一步只看当前字符，也可以画成一个有限状态机。
followUps.aEn: Write it by phase: skip spaces, read a sign, read digits, stop at the first non-digit. Each step looks at one character; it can also be drawn as a finite-state machine.

lc-11.takeawayZh: 双指针的正确性来自「排除论证」：说清楚被跳过的组合为什么不可能更好。
lc-11.takeawayEn: Two-pointer correctness is an exclusion argument: explain why every skipped pair cannot do better.

followUps.qZh: 为什么移动较短的那一边？
followUps.qEn: Why move the shorter side?
followUps.aZh: 面积受短边限制。移动长边时宽度变小，高度上限仍是那条短边，面积不可能变大；所以短边和其余位置的配对都不会更好，可以直接排除。
followUps.aEn: The area is capped by the shorter line. Moving the taller one shrinks the width while the shorter line still caps the height, so it cannot help; every remaining pair with the shorter line is ruled out.

followUps.qZh: 改成求能接住多少雨水（每个位置都能存水）？
followUps.qEn: What if every position can hold water, how much is trapped?
followUps.aZh: 那是另一道题：每个位置的水量是左右两侧最高柱子中较矮的那个，减去自身高度。
followUps.aEn: That is a different problem: the water above each position is the lower of the tallest bars on its left and right, minus its own height.

lc-15.takeawayZh: k 数之和：排序后固定前 k−2 个数，最后两个用双指针；每一层都要去重。
lc-15.takeawayEn: k-sum: sort, fix the first k−2 numbers and use two pointers for the last two; deduplicate at every level.

followUps.qZh: 怎么去重才能不漏也不多？
followUps.qEn: How do you deduplicate without losing triplets?
followUps.aZh: 排序后，固定的第一个数和前一个相同就跳过；双指针找到一组后，左右指针各自跳过相同的值再继续。
followUps.aEn: After sorting, skip a first number equal to the previous one; after each hit, move both pointers past equal values before continuing.

followUps.qZh: 改成和最接近 target 的三元组？
followUps.qEn: What about the triplet closest to target?
followUps.aZh: 同样排序加双指针，不需要去重：每步更新最接近的答案，和小了左指针右移，大了右指针左移。
followUps.aEn: Same sort and two pointers without deduplication: update the closest sum each step and move left or right by the comparison.

lc-16.takeawayZh: 求最接近的值：指针怎么移动只看和与 target 的大小关系；更新答案是另一件事，两者分开写。
lc-16.takeawayEn: For the closest value, pointer moves depend only on the sum versus target; updating the answer is a separate step, so write them apart.

followUps.qZh: 什么时候可以提前结束？
followUps.qEn: When can you stop early?
followUps.aZh: 和恰好等于 target 时差为 0，不可能更好，直接返回。
followUps.aEn: When the sum equals target the difference is 0 and cannot improve, so return at once.

followUps.qZh: 改成统计和小于 target 的三元组个数？
followUps.qEn: Count the triplets with sum below target?
followUps.aZh: 固定第一个数后，双指针在和 < target 时，左端和 (l, r] 都能配，一次加 r − l 个，O(n²)。
followUps.aEn: After fixing the first number, whenever the sum is below target the left value pairs with everything in (l, r]: add r − l at once. O(n²).

lc-18.takeawayZh: 多层枚举加双指针：每一层都去重，和用 64 位整数计算。
lc-18.takeawayEn: Nested loops plus two pointers: deduplicate at every level and add in 64-bit integers.

followUps.qZh: 四个数相加会溢出吗？
followUps.qEn: Can adding four numbers overflow?
followUps.aZh: 会。四个 10^9 相加是 4×10^9，超出 32 位；Java 和 C++ 要先转成 long 再加，否则四个 10^9 会被误判为和等于 −294967296。
followUps.aEn: Yes. Four 10^9 make 4×10^9, beyond 32 bits; in Java and C++ convert to long before adding, or four 10^9 would wrongly match −294967296.

followUps.qZh: 推广到 k 数之和？
followUps.qEn: Generalise to k numbers?
followUps.aZh: 递归：kSum 固定一个数后调用 (k−1)Sum，到 k = 2 时用双指针。复杂度 O(n^(k−1))，每一层都跳过重复值。
followUps.aEn: Recurse: kSum fixes one number and calls (k−1)Sum, down to two pointers at k = 2. O(n^(k−1)), skipping repeats at each level.

lc-26.takeawayZh: 有序数组去重：读指针扫描，写指针守住「已经处理好的前缀」。先把这个不变量说清楚，变体只是比较的对象变了。
lc-26.takeawayEn: Deduplicating a sorted array: the read pointer scans, the write pointer guards the finished prefix. State that invariant first; the variants only change what you compare against.

followUps.qZh: 每个值最多保留两个呢？
followUps.qEn: What if each value may stay up to twice?
followUps.aZh: 写指针比较的对象从「上一个保留的值」换成「往前数第 2 个保留的值」：`nums[i] != nums[w-2]` 时才写入。最多保留 k 个就和 `w-k` 位置比。
followUps.aEn: Compare with the value two slots back in the kept prefix instead of the last kept one: write only when `nums[i] != nums[w-2]`. To keep up to k copies, compare with position `w-k`.

followUps.qZh: 如果数组没有排好序呢？
followUps.qEn: What if the array is not sorted?
followUps.aZh: 相同的值不再相邻，读写指针就不够了。要么先排序（O(n log n)，原来的顺序会丢），要么用哈希集合记录见过的值，保持第一次出现的顺序，代价是 O(n) 额外空间。
followUps.aEn: Equal values are no longer adjacent, so the two pointers alone fail. Either sort first (O(n log n), losing the original order) or keep a hash set of values seen and keep first occurrences in order, at O(n) extra space.

lc-27.takeawayZh: 原地删除：写指针只收下要留的元素。不要求保持顺序时，可以拿末尾元素来填坑，写操作更少。
lc-27.takeawayEn: Removing in place: the write pointer only takes elements that stay. When order does not matter, fill each hole with the last element and write less.

followUps.qZh: 要删的元素很少时，能不能少写几次？
followUps.qEn: If few elements need removing, can you write less?
followUps.aZh: 遇到 val 就用当前末尾的元素覆盖它，并把长度减一；当前位置先不前进，因为换过来的值还没检查。写操作次数等于要删的个数，代价是不再保持原顺序。
followUps.aEn: When you meet val, overwrite it with the current last element and shrink the length; do not advance, since the moved-in value is unchecked. Writes equal the number removed, at the cost of the original order.

followUps.qZh: 如果要删的是一组值，而不是一个？
followUps.qEn: What if a whole set of values must go?
followUps.aZh: 把这组值放进哈希集合，判断条件换成「不在集合里才保留」，其余不变，时间仍是 O(n)。
followUps.aEn: Put the values in a hash set and keep an element only when it is not in the set; nothing else changes and it stays O(n).

lc-28.takeawayZh: KMP 的前缀函数记录「已匹配部分自身的最长相同前后缀」，失配时文本指针不回退。
lc-28.takeawayEn: KMP's prefix function stores the longest border of what has matched, so the text pointer never moves back on a mismatch.

followUps.qZh: 要找出所有出现位置（可以重叠）？
followUps.qEn: Find every occurrence, overlaps included?
followUps.aZh: KMP 匹配成功后不要重置，令 j = π[j−1] 继续，就能找到所有位置，包括重叠的，总共 O(n + m)。
followUps.aEn: After a full match, do not reset: set j = π[j−1] and continue. That finds every occurrence, overlapping ones too, in O(n + m).

followUps.qZh: 还有别的线性做法吗？
followUps.qEn: Any other linear-time methods?
followUps.aZh: Rabin-Karp 滚动哈希：平均 O(n + m)，哈希相同时再逐字比对。Z 函数：对 needle + "#" + haystack 求 Z 数组，值等于 m 的位置就是匹配。
followUps.aEn: Rabin-Karp with a rolling hash, O(n + m) on average, comparing characters on a hash match. Or the Z-function of needle + "#" + haystack: positions with value m are matches.

lc-30.takeawayZh: 把「字符」换成「定长单词」：窗口按单词长度对齐地滑动，计数的是单词。
lc-30.takeawayEn: Swap characters for fixed-length words: slide the window aligned to the word length and count words.

followUps.qZh: words 里有重复单词怎么办？
followUps.qEn: What if words contains duplicates?
followUps.aZh: 用计数表而不是集合：窗口里某个单词的次数超过它在 words 里的次数时，就从左边收缩。
followUps.aEn: Use a count map, not a set: when a word appears in the window more often than in words, shrink from the left.

followUps.qZh: 为什么按起点模 w 分组滑动？
followUps.qEn: Why group start positions by index mod w?
followUps.aZh: 合法的起点和单词边界对齐。按起点模 w 分成 w 组，每组里窗口一次移动一个单词，每个单词进出各一次，总共 O(n·w)，不用对每个起点重新数。
followUps.aEn: Valid starts align with word boundaries. Split starts into w groups by index mod w; within a group the window moves one word at a time and each word enters and leaves once, O(n·w) instead of recounting per start.

lc-41.takeawayZh: 答案的范围被数组长度限住时，把每个值放到「它该在的下标」上，再找第一个不在位的。
lc-41.takeawayEn: When the length bounds the answer, put each value at the index it belongs to, then find the first slot that is wrong.

followUps.qZh: 为什么答案一定在 [1, n+1] 里？
followUps.qEn: Why must the answer lie in [1, n+1]?
followUps.aZh: n 个数最多占满 1..n。占满了答案就是 n+1，没占满答案就在 1..n 的空位里。所以只需关心 1..n 的值，其余的都可以忽略。
followUps.aEn: n numbers can fill at most 1..n. If they do, the answer is n+1; otherwise it is a gap within 1..n. Only values in 1..n matter; everything else can be ignored.

followUps.qZh: 如果数组是只读的？
followUps.qEn: What if the array is read-only?
followUps.aZh: 原地交换不能用了。用 n+1 位的位图（O(n) 空间），或者复制一份排序，O(n log n)。
followUps.aEn: In-place swapping is out. Use a bitmap of n+1 bits (O(n) space), or sort a copy in O(n log n).

lc-42.takeawayZh: 每个位置的水位 = min(左边最高, 右边最高)；双指针让较低的一侧先结算。
lc-42.takeawayEn: The water level at each position is min(tallest on the left, tallest on the right); two pointers settle the lower side first.

followUps.qZh: 用单调栈怎么算？
followUps.qEn: How does a monotonic stack solve it?
followUps.aZh: 维护高度递减的栈。遇到更高的柱子时弹出栈顶作为坑底：宽度是当前下标和新栈顶之间的距离，高度是两边较矮者减去坑底，一层一层累加。
followUps.aEn: Keep a stack of decreasing heights. A taller bar pops the top as the pit floor: its width is the distance between the current index and the new top, its height the lower side minus the floor, added layer by layer.

followUps.qZh: 改成二维（每个格子有高度）呢？
followUps.qEn: What about the 2-D version, a grid of heights?
followUps.aZh: 从边界出发，用小根堆做类似 Dijkstra 的扩展：每次取出最低的边界格向内扩展，邻格比当前水位低就积水，O(mn log(mn))。
followUps.aEn: Start from the border and expand with a min-heap, Dijkstra-style: always take the lowest boundary cell; a lower neighbour fills up to the current level. O(mn log(mn)).

lc-48.takeawayZh: 旋转可以拆成两次翻转。先把下标映射 (i, j) → (j, n−1−i) 写出来，再挑一组翻转去实现它。
lc-48.takeawayEn: A rotation is two reflections. Write the index map (i, j) → (j, n−1−i) first, then pick the pair of flips that realises it.

followUps.qZh: 逆时针旋转 90 度呢？旋转 180 度呢？
followUps.qEn: Counter-clockwise by 90 degrees? By 180?
followUps.aZh: 逆时针：先转置，再上下翻转（或先把每行反转再转置）。180 度：上下翻转一次，再把每行左右翻转一次。
followUps.aEn: Counter-clockwise: transpose, then flip upside down (or reverse each row, then transpose). 180 degrees: flip upside down, then reverse every row.

followUps.qZh: 如果矩阵是 m×n、不是方阵呢？
followUps.qEn: What if the matrix is m×n, not square?
followUps.aZh: 没法原地做：旋转后形状变成 n×m。新建一个矩阵，按 `new[j][m-1-i] = old[i][j]` 填进去。
followUps.aEn: It cannot be done in place, because the shape becomes n×m. Allocate a new matrix and fill `new[j][m-1-i] = old[i][j]`.

lc-49.takeawayZh: 分组问题：给每个元素算一个「等价类的规范键」，再按键放进哈希表。
lc-49.takeawayEn: Grouping comes down to a canonical key per equivalence class, then a hash map from key to group.

followUps.qZh: 字符串不只小写字母，而是任意 Unicode 呢？
followUps.qEn: What if strings hold any Unicode, not just lowercase letters?
followUps.aZh: 长度 26 的计数数组不够用了。键可以用排序后的字符串，或者把 (字符, 次数) 排好序拼成一个键。
followUps.aEn: A 26-slot count array no longer works. Use the sorted string as the key, or sort the (character, count) pairs and join them.

followUps.qZh: 只判断两个字符串是不是异位词？
followUps.qEn: Only decide whether two strings are anagrams?
followUps.aZh: 长度不同直接返回 false；否则一次计数，第一个串加、第二个串减，最后全为 0 就是。
followUps.aEn: Different lengths mean false. Otherwise count once, adding for the first string and subtracting for the second, and check that everything ends at 0.

lc-53.takeawayZh: 「以 i 结尾的最优」是子数组问题的基本状态：前面累积的和是负数，就丢掉重来。
lc-53.takeawayEn: "Best ending at i" is the basic state for subarray problems: if the running sum before i is negative, drop it and start over.

followUps.qZh: 还要返回子数组的起止位置？
followUps.qEn: Also return the start and end of the subarray?
followUps.aZh: Kadane 里当前和被重置的位置就是新的起点。每次更新最大值时，记下这个起点和当前下标。
followUps.aEn: In Kadane, the point where the running sum restarts is the new start. Whenever the maximum improves, record that start and the current index.

followUps.qZh: 如果数组首尾相连（环形）？
followUps.qEn: What if the array is circular?
followUps.aZh: 答案要么不跨过首尾（普通 Kadane），要么跨过：等于总和减去最小子数组和。全是负数时只能取前者。
followUps.aEn: The answer either does not wrap (plain Kadane) or wraps, which equals the total minus the minimum subarray sum. If everything is negative, only the first counts.

followUps.qZh: 用分治怎么做？
followUps.qEn: How would divide and conquer do it?
followUps.aZh: 最大子数组要么在左半，要么在右半，要么跨过中点（从中点向两边分别取最大扩展）。T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n)，即 O(n log n)；写成线段树还能回答区间查询。
followUps.aEn: The best subarray lies in the left half, the right half, or crosses the middle (best extension each way from the middle). T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n), so O(n log n); as a segment tree it also answers range queries.

lc-65.takeawayZh: 格式校验题：先写出文法（符号、整数部分、小数部分、指数），再照着文法写状态。
lc-65.takeawayEn: For format validation, write the grammar first (sign, integer part, fraction, exponent), then code states that follow it.

followUps.qZh: 还要支持十六进制（"0x1F"）或数字中的下划线（"1_000"）？
followUps.qEn: Also accept hex ("0x1F") or underscores in digits ("1_000")?
followUps.aZh: 在状态机里加状态和转移：0x 之后只接受十六进制数字；下划线只能出现在两个数字之间。规则越多，状态表越比一串 if 好维护。
followUps.aEn: Add states and transitions: after 0x accept only hex digits; an underscore only between two digits. The more rules, the more a state table beats a chain of ifs.

followUps.qZh: 能直接用 float() 或正则吗？
followUps.qEn: Could you just call float() or use a regex?
followUps.aZh: 面试里通常要求自己实现。float() 还接受 "inf"、"nan" 和 "1_0"，和题意不同。正则可以写成 `^[+-]?(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)([eE][+-]?\d+)?$`，但要能解释每一段。
followUps.aEn: Interviews usually want it by hand. float() also accepts "inf", "nan" and "1_0", which the problem rejects. A regex such as `^[+-]?(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)([eE][+-]?\d+)?$` works if you can explain every part.

lc-68.takeawayZh: 模拟题先分清几类行：普通行、只有一个词的行、最后一行，各自的对齐规则不同。
lc-68.takeawayEn: For simulations, separate the cases first: ordinary lines, single-word lines and the last line each align differently.

followUps.qZh: 空格不能均分时，多出来的放在哪？
followUps.qEn: Where do leftover spaces go when they do not divide evenly?
followUps.aZh: 从左往右，每个间隔多放一个：总空格数 s、间隔数 g，前 s mod g 个间隔放 ⌊s/g⌋+1 个，其余放 ⌊s/g⌋ 个。
followUps.aEn: Left to right, one extra per gap: with s spaces and g gaps, the first s mod g gaps get ⌊s/g⌋+1 and the rest ⌊s/g⌋.

followUps.qZh: 要让每行末尾空白的平方和最小（更好看的排版）？
followUps.qEn: Minimise the sum of squared trailing spaces for nicer layout?
followUps.aZh: 贪心就不再最优了，要用动态规划：dp[i] 表示从第 i 个词排到结尾的最小代价，枚举这一行放到第几个词。这是 TeX 断行思路的简化版。
followUps.aEn: Greedy is no longer optimal; use DP: dp[i] is the least cost to lay out words i onward, trying every last word for the current line. It is a simplified form of TeX line breaking.

lc-75.takeawayZh: 三指针维护三段不变量：[0, lo) 全是 0，[lo, i) 全是 1，(hi, n) 全是 2。和 hi 交换过来的元素还没检查，所以 i 不前进。
lc-75.takeawayEn: Three pointers keep three regions: [0, lo) holds 0s, [lo, i) holds 1s, (hi, n) holds 2s. An element swapped in from hi is unchecked, so i does not advance.

followUps.qZh: 如果有 k 种颜色呢？
followUps.qEn: What if there are k colours?
followUps.aZh: 计数排序：先数每种颜色出现几次，再按顺序写回，O(n + k) 时间、O(k) 空间。k 很大而又要求常数空间时，可以对颜色区间做分治的划分。
followUps.aEn: Counting sort: count each colour, then write them back in order, O(n + k) time and O(k) space. If k is large and space must stay constant, partition recursively on ranges of colours.

followUps.qZh: 三路划分还能用在哪？
followUps.qEn: Where else does three-way partitioning help?
followUps.aZh: 快速排序遇到大量重复值时用三路划分：等于 pivot 的一段不再递归，重复多的输入就不会退化到 O(n²)。
followUps.aEn: In quicksort with many repeated values: the block equal to the pivot is never recursed into, so duplicate-heavy input no longer degrades to O(n²).

lc-76.takeawayZh: 覆盖型窗口：先扩张到满足，再尽量收缩，在收缩的过程中更新最短答案。
lc-76.takeawayEn: Covering windows: grow until satisfied, then shrink as far as possible, updating the shortest answer while shrinking.

followUps.qZh: 为什么要区分「种类满足」和「次数满足」？
followUps.qEn: Why distinguish "has the letter" from "has enough of it"?
followUps.aZh: t 里有重复字符（如 "aa"）时，窗口里出现一个 a 不够。维护「还缺几个字符」（按次数算）：字符进窗口时如果它还有缺口就减一，缺口为 0 才收缩。
followUps.aEn: When t repeats a letter ("aa"), one a is not enough. Track how many characters are still missing, counting multiplicity: an incoming character reduces it only if still needed, and shrink once it reaches 0.

followUps.qZh: s 很长，但 t 的字符在 s 里很少出现？
followUps.qEn: What if s is long but t's letters are rare in it?
followUps.aZh: 先把 s 中属于 t 的字符位置过滤出来，只在这些位置上滑动窗口，跳过无关字符。
followUps.aEn: Filter the positions of s whose characters occur in t and slide the window over those only, skipping everything else.

lc-80.takeawayZh: 「最多保留 k 个」的有序去重：拿当前值和结果里往前数第 k 个比较，k = 1 就是普通去重。
lc-80.takeawayEn: Sorted dedup keeping at most k copies: compare the current value with the k-th last kept one; k = 1 is plain dedup.

followUps.qZh: 改成每个值最多保留 k 个？
followUps.qEn: Generalise to at most k copies?
followUps.aZh: 条件换成 `w < k or nums[i] != nums[w-k]`。数组有序，如果结果里往前数第 k 个和当前值相同，就说明这个值已经留了 k 个。
followUps.aEn: Use `w < k or nums[i] != nums[w-k]`. Since the array is sorted, if the k-th last kept value equals the current one, that value already has k copies.

followUps.qZh: 为什么和 nums[w-2] 比，而不和 nums[i-2] 比？
followUps.qEn: Why compare with nums[w-2] rather than nums[i-2]?
followUps.aZh: 判断的是「结果里已经留了几个」，结果是写指针之前的前缀。`nums[i-2]` 那个位置可能已经被写指针覆盖成别的值，拿它比较会在重复较多时出错。
followUps.aEn: The question is how many copies the result already holds, and the result is the prefix before the write pointer. Position `i-2` may already have been overwritten, so comparing with it breaks on longer runs.

lc-88.takeawayZh: 原地合并时从空位那一端开始写，就不会覆盖还没读的值。两个有序序列的合并，永远是「比较两个头，取一个」。
lc-88.takeawayEn: Merging in place, write from the end with the free space so nothing unread is overwritten. Merging two sorted sequences is always: compare the two heads, take one.

followUps.qZh: nums1 后面没有预留空间，必须返回新数组呢？
followUps.qEn: What if nums1 has no spare room and you must return a new array?
followUps.aZh: 从前往后双指针合并到新数组即可，O(m + n) 额外空间。预留空间的意义正是让「从后往前写」不覆盖还没读的值。
followUps.aEn: Merge front to back into a new array with two pointers, O(m + n) extra space. The spare room exists so that writing from the back never overwrites unread values.

followUps.qZh: 合并 k 个有序数组呢？
followUps.qEn: And merging k sorted arrays?
followUps.aZh: 用小根堆存每个数组当前最小的元素，每次弹出最小的并推进那个数组，O(N log k)；也可以两两分治合并。链表版本是同一个思路。
followUps.aEn: Keep each array's current head in a min-heap, pop the smallest and advance that array: O(N log k). Pairwise divide-and-conquer merging also works; the linked-list version is the same idea.

lc-125.takeawayZh: 回文判断：两端指针向中间走；先规整（跳过无关字符、统一大小写），再比较。
lc-125.takeawayEn: Palindrome checks: pointers move inward from both ends; normalise first (skip irrelevant characters, fold case), then compare.

followUps.qZh: 最多允许删除一个字符呢？
followUps.qEn: What if you may delete at most one character?
followUps.aZh: 双指针遇到第一处不相等时，分别试着跳过左边或右边的字符，再检查剩下的区间是不是回文。
followUps.aEn: At the first mismatch, try skipping the left character or the right one, and check whether the rest is a palindrome.

followUps.qZh: 输入是一个只能从头顺序读一遍的流呢？
followUps.qEn: What if the input is a stream you can read only once, front to back?
followUps.aZh: 双指针需要从两端读，流做不到。可以同时维护正向和反向两个多项式哈希，读完后比较是否相等；这种判断是概率性的。
followUps.aEn: Two pointers need both ends, which a stream cannot give. Keep a forward and a backward polynomial hash while reading and compare them at the end; the answer is probabilistic.

lc-128.takeawayZh: 只从序列的起点（x − 1 不存在）开始往后数，每个数最多被数一次，总共 O(n)。
lc-128.takeawayEn: Count only from the start of a run (where x − 1 is absent); each number is counted at most once, O(n) in total.

followUps.qZh: 还要返回这段连续序列本身？
followUps.qEn: Also return the run itself?
followUps.aZh: 记下最长时的起点 x 和长度 L，答案就是 x, x+1, …, x+L−1。
followUps.aEn: Remember the start x and length L of the longest run; the answer is x, x+1, …, x+L−1.

followUps.qZh: 数字是流式到来的，要随时回答当前最长？
followUps.qEn: Numbers arrive as a stream; answer the current longest at any time?
followUps.aZh: 用「端点哈希表」：新数 x 到来时，查以 x − 1 结尾和以 x + 1 开头的区间长度，合并后只更新新区间两端的记录，每次 O(1)。也可以用并查集。
followUps.aEn: Keep a map from run endpoints to lengths: when x arrives, look up the run ending at x − 1 and the one starting at x + 1, merge them and update only the two new endpoints, O(1) each. Union-find also works.

lc-151.takeawayZh: 「反转单词顺序」= 整体反转一次，再把每个单词反转回来；清理多余空格是单独的一步。
lc-151.takeawayEn: Reversing word order is reversing everything, then each word back; collapsing extra spaces is a separate step.

followUps.qZh: 字符串是可变的字符数组，要求 O(1) 额外空间？
followUps.qEn: If the string is a mutable char array, can you use O(1) extra space?
followUps.aZh: 先整体反转，再逐个反转每个单词，最后用读写双指针原地压缩多余的空格。
followUps.aEn: Reverse the whole array, reverse each word, then squeeze out extra spaces in place with read and write pointers.

followUps.qZh: 改成每个单词内部反转、单词顺序不变？
followUps.qEn: Reverse each word but keep the word order?
followUps.aZh: 只做「逐个反转单词」那一步即可，整体反转那一步不要。
followUps.aEn: Do only the per-word reversal and skip reversing the whole string.

lc-159.takeawayZh: 「最多 k 种」的最长窗口：计数表加种类数，种类超了就收缩左端。
lc-159.takeawayEn: Longest window with at most k kinds: a count table plus a kind counter, shrinking when there are too many.

followUps.qZh: 推广到最多 k 种？
followUps.qEn: Generalise to at most k kinds?
followUps.aZh: 计数表加种类数，种类数超过 k 就收缩左端，代码几乎不变。
followUps.aEn: Same count table and kind counter; shrink when the kinds exceed k. The code barely changes.

followUps.qZh: 能不能只记每种字符最后出现的位置？
followUps.qEn: Could you store only each character's last position?
followUps.aZh: 可以。种类超过 2 时，删掉「最后出现位置最靠左」的那种字符，左端跳到它的最后位置 + 1。种类少时很快；k 大时找最靠左的位置要用有序结构。
followUps.aEn: Yes. With a third kind, drop the kind whose last position is leftmost and jump the left end past it. Fast for few kinds; for large k, find the leftmost with an ordered structure.

lc-167.takeawayZh: 有序数组上的配对：每比较一次，就能排除一整行或一整列的组合。
lc-167.takeawayEn: Pairing on a sorted array: every comparison rules out a whole row or column of pairs.

followUps.qZh: 为什么每次移动一端不会错过答案？
followUps.qEn: Why does moving one end never skip the answer?
followUps.aZh: 和小于 target 时，左端和任何右端（都不比当前右端大）相加都不够，左端可以整个排除；和大于 target 时同理排除右端。每一步排除一整行或一整列，不会漏。
followUps.aEn: When the sum is too small, the left value cannot reach target with any right value (none exceeds the current one), so the left end is ruled out; symmetrically for the right. Each step removes a whole row or column, so nothing is missed.

followUps.qZh: 要统计和 ≤ target 的数对个数？
followUps.qEn: Count the pairs with sum ≤ target?
followUps.aZh: 和 ≤ target 时，左端和 (l, r] 中任何一个配对都满足，一次加上 r − l，然后左端前进；否则右端后退。O(n)。
followUps.aEn: When the sum is ≤ target, the left value works with every index in (l, r]: add r − l and advance left; otherwise move right back. O(n).

lc-169.takeawayZh: 摩尔投票靠「两两抵消」：多数元素抵消不完。得到的只是候选人；题目不保证存在时，要再数一遍验证。
lc-169.takeawayEn: Boyer-Moore voting cancels pairs, and a majority cannot be cancelled out. It yields only a candidate; unless a majority is guaranteed, count it again to verify.

followUps.qZh: 如果不保证多数元素一定存在？
followUps.qEn: What if a majority is not guaranteed?
followUps.aZh: 投票只给出候选人。再扫一遍数它出现的次数，超过 n/2 才返回，否则说明不存在。
followUps.aEn: Voting only gives a candidate. Scan again to count it and return it only if it appears more than n/2 times; otherwise there is none.

followUps.qZh: 找出所有出现次数超过 n/3 的元素？
followUps.qEn: Find every element appearing more than n/3 times?
followUps.aZh: 这样的元素最多两个。用两个候选人、两个计数器投票，最后再分别验证。
followUps.aEn: There are at most two. Vote with two candidates and two counters, then verify each one.

lc-187.takeawayZh: 定长子串去重：用滚动编码把每个窗口变成一个整数，O(1) 更新。
lc-187.takeawayEn: Deduplicating fixed-length substrings: a rolling encoding turns each window into an integer updated in O(1).

followUps.qZh: 把长度 10 换成任意 L，L 很大时怎么办？
followUps.qEn: What if the length is any L, possibly large?
followUps.aZh: 直接存子串是 O(nL)。用滚动哈希（Rabin-Karp）每步 O(1) 更新，哈希相同时再比对原串防碰撞。DNA 只有 4 种字符，L ≤ 32 时可以用每字符 2 位装进 64 位整数，不会碰撞。
followUps.aEn: Storing substrings costs O(nL). A rolling hash (Rabin-Karp) updates in O(1) per step; compare the actual strings on a hash match. With 4 letters and L ≤ 32, 2 bits per letter fit in a 64-bit integer with no collisions.

followUps.qZh: 改成找最长的重复子串？
followUps.qEn: Find the longest repeated substring instead?
followUps.aZh: 对长度二分：有长度 L 的重复子串，就一定有更短的。每次用滚动哈希检查，O(n log n)；也可以用后缀数组。
followUps.aEn: Binary search on the length, since a repeat of length L implies shorter ones; check each length with a rolling hash, O(n log n). A suffix array also works.

lc-209.takeawayZh: 滑动窗口需要「扩张让条件变好、收缩让条件变差」的单调性；元素都为正时，和满足这一点。
lc-209.takeawayEn: A sliding window needs monotonicity: growing helps, shrinking hurts. With positive elements, the sum has it.

followUps.qZh: 如果数组里有负数？
followUps.qEn: What if the array has negatives?
followUps.aZh: 窗口和不再随右端单调增加，收缩的依据失效。改用前缀和加单调队列：对每个右端，在前缀和递增的队列里找满足 P[r] − P[l] ≥ target 的最近的 l，O(n)。
followUps.aEn: The window sum is no longer monotone, so shrinking has no basis. Use prefix sums with a monotonic deque: for each right end, find the nearest l with P[r] − P[l] ≥ target in a deque of increasing prefix sums, O(n).

followUps.qZh: 前缀和加二分为什么成立？
followUps.qEn: Why does prefix sums plus binary search work?
followUps.aZh: 元素全为正时前缀和严格递增。对每个左端点，二分找第一个满足 P[r] − P[l] ≥ target 的 r，O(n log n)。
followUps.aEn: With positive elements the prefix sums strictly increase, so for each left end binary search the first r with P[r] − P[l] ≥ target: O(n log n).

lc-214.takeawayZh: 「最长回文前缀」可以变成字符串匹配：找 s 的前缀和 reverse(s) 的后缀相等的最长长度。
lc-214.takeawayEn: The longest palindromic prefix is a matching problem: the longest prefix of s equal to a suffix of reverse(s).

followUps.qZh: 改成只能在后面添加字符？
followUps.qEn: What if characters may only be appended?
followUps.aZh: 对称地找最长的回文后缀，把它前面的部分反转后加到末尾；也可以对反转后的串套用同一个做法。
followUps.aEn: Find the longest palindromic suffix instead and append the reverse of what precedes it, or run the same method on the reversed string.

followUps.qZh: 为什么要用 s + "#" + reverse(s) 的前缀函数？
followUps.qEn: Why the prefix function of s + "#" + reverse(s)?
followUps.aZh: 它的最后一个值，就是「s 的前缀等于 reverse(s) 的后缀」的最长长度，也就是 s 的最长回文前缀；"#" 防止匹配越过分界。
followUps.aEn: Its last value is the longest prefix of s that equals a suffix of reverse(s), which is the longest palindromic prefix of s; the "#" stops matches from crossing the boundary.

lc-219.takeawayZh: 「下标距离 ≤ k」就是一个长度为 k 的滑动窗口；记住每个值最后出现的位置就够了。
lc-219.takeawayEn: "Index distance ≤ k" is a sliding window of length k; remembering each value's last position is enough.

followUps.qZh: 改成「值相差不超过 t」呢？
followUps.qEn: What if values only need to be within t of each other?
followUps.aZh: 窗口里要找最接近的值：用有序集合，O(n log k)；或者按宽度 t + 1 分桶，同桶必然满足，只需再查相邻两个桶，O(n)。
followUps.aEn: You need the closest value in the window: an ordered set gives O(n log k); buckets of width t + 1 give O(n), since one bucket always satisfies it and only the two neighbouring buckets need checking.

followUps.qZh: 能只用 O(k) 的空间吗？
followUps.qEn: Can you use only O(k) space?
followUps.aZh: 用大小为 k 的滑动窗口集合：放入 nums[i] 前先删掉 nums[i − k − 1]；集合里已有同样的值就返回 true。
followUps.aEn: Keep a window set of size k: before adding nums[i], remove nums[i − k − 1]; if the value is already in the set, return true.

lc-220.takeawayZh: 「值接近」可以用分桶变成「同桶或邻桶」，把有序结构的 log 去掉。
lc-220.takeawayEn: Bucketing turns "close in value" into "same or neighbouring bucket" and removes the log factor of an ordered set.

followUps.qZh: 为什么桶宽要取 valueDiff + 1？
followUps.qEn: Why make buckets valueDiff + 1 wide?
followUps.aZh: 宽度为 t + 1 时，同一个桶里任意两数之差 ≤ t，必然满足；不同桶里只有相邻的桶可能满足，所以每个数只需查三个桶。t = 0 时桶宽为 1，正好退化成判等。
followUps.aEn: With width t + 1, any two numbers in one bucket differ by at most t; across buckets only neighbours can qualify, so each number checks three buckets. With t = 0 the width is 1 and it reduces to equality.

followUps.qZh: 负数分桶要注意什么？
followUps.qEn: What goes wrong with negative numbers?
followUps.aZh: 桶号必须向下取整。Python 的 // 本来就是；Java 和 C++ 的除法向零取整，要用 Math.floorDiv 或手动修正。否则桶宽为 2 时，−1 和 1 都会被分进桶 0，而它们相差 2。
followUps.aEn: Bucket ids must round down. Python's // does; Java and C++ division truncates toward zero, so use Math.floorDiv or adjust by hand. Otherwise, with width 2, both −1 and 1 land in bucket 0 although they differ by 2.

lc-229.takeawayZh: 出现超过 n/k 次的元素最多 k−1 个：投票找候选，计数做验证。
lc-229.takeawayEn: At most k−1 elements appear more than n/k times: vote for candidates, then count to verify.

followUps.qZh: 推广到出现超过 n/k 次？
followUps.qEn: Generalise to more than n/k times?
followUps.aZh: 维护 k−1 个候选人和计数器。遇到新值且没有空位时，所有计数减一。最后逐个验证，O(nk) 时间、O(k) 空间。
followUps.aEn: Keep k−1 candidates with counters. When a new value finds no free slot, decrement every counter. Verify each at the end: O(nk) time, O(k) space.

followUps.qZh: 为什么最后必须再数一遍？
followUps.qEn: Why must you count again at the end?
followUps.aZh: 投票只保证真正的答案一定在候选人里，不保证候选人都是答案。比如 [1,2,3]，投票结束时总会留下候选人，但每个值都只出现一次。
followUps.aEn: Voting only guarantees that every real answer is among the candidates, not that every candidate is an answer. In [1,2,3] some candidates survive, yet each value appears once.

lc-238.takeawayZh: 「除了自己」的聚合 = 左边的聚合 × 右边的聚合。前缀和后缀分开算，最后合起来。
lc-238.takeawayEn: "Everything except me" is the left aggregate combined with the right one. Compute prefix and suffix separately, then combine.

followUps.qZh: 能做到 O(1) 额外空间吗（输出数组不算）？
followUps.qEn: Can you use O(1) extra space, not counting the output?
followUps.aZh: 先把前缀积写进输出数组，再从右往左扫，用一个变量累乘后缀积，乘进对应位置。
followUps.aEn: Write the prefix products into the output array, then sweep right to left with one running suffix product, multiplying it in.

followUps.qZh: 如果允许用除法，要注意什么？
followUps.qEn: If division were allowed, what must you watch?
followUps.aZh: 零的个数。没有零：总积除以自己。恰好一个零：只有零所在的位置是其余数的积，其余为 0。两个及以上零：全部为 0。
followUps.aEn: The number of zeros. None: divide the total product by the element. Exactly one: only the zero's slot gets the product of the rest, the others are 0. Two or more: all 0.

lc-249.takeawayZh: 找一个在「平移」下不变的量作为键：相邻字符的差（对 26 取模）。
lc-249.takeawayEn: Use a quantity that shifting does not change as the key: the differences between adjacent letters, modulo 26.

followUps.qZh: 为什么差值要对 26 取模？
followUps.qEn: Why take the differences modulo 26?
followUps.aZh: z 之后回到 a，所以 "az" 和 "ba" 是同一组：它们的差分分别是 25 和 −1，模 26 后都是 25。不取模就会把它们分开。
followUps.aEn: After z comes a again, so "az" and "ba" belong together: their steps are 25 and −1, both 25 modulo 26. Without the modulo they would be split.

followUps.qZh: 能不能不用差分，换一种键？
followUps.qEn: Is there a key other than the differences?
followUps.aZh: 把每个串平移到首字母是 a：每个字符减去首字母的偏移再模 26。平移后的串本身就是键，效果相同。
followUps.aEn: Shift every string so it starts with a: subtract the first letter's offset from each character, modulo 26. The shifted string itself is the key.

lc-266.takeawayZh: 能不能排成回文，只取决于出现奇数次的字符有几个：不超过一个就行。
lc-266.takeawayEn: Whether a palindrome can be formed depends only on how many characters occur an odd number of times: at most one.

followUps.qZh: 列出所有不重复的回文排列？
followUps.qEn: List every distinct palindromic permutation?
followUps.aZh: 每个字符取一半的个数组成左半的多重集，回溯生成不重复的排列（同一层跳过相同字符），再拼上中心字符和左半的反转。
followUps.aEn: Take half of each character's count as the left-half multiset, backtrack over its distinct permutations (skipping equal letters at the same depth), then add the centre and the mirror.

followUps.qZh: 能只用一个整数记录状态吗？
followUps.qEn: Can a single integer hold the state?
followUps.aZh: 小写字母只有 26 个，用 26 位掩码：遇到一个字符就翻转对应的位。最后掩码为 0，或只有一位是 1（`mask & (mask - 1) == 0`），就可以。
followUps.aEn: With 26 lowercase letters, keep a 26-bit mask and flip a bit per character. The answer is yes when the mask ends as 0 or with one bit set (`mask & (mask - 1) == 0`).

lc-273.takeawayZh: 三位一组，组内处理百、十、个；组与组之间加单位，全 0 的组跳过。
lc-273.takeawayEn: Work in groups of three digits, handling hundreds, tens and ones inside; add a scale word between groups and skip all-zero groups.

followUps.qZh: 要支持负数或 64 位整数？
followUps.qEn: Support negatives or 64-bit numbers?
followUps.aZh: 负数加 "Negative" 前缀再处理绝对值；注意 −2^63 取绝对值会溢出，要先换成更宽或无符号的类型。更大的数只需继续加 Trillion、Quadrillion 等单位，三位一组的逻辑不变。
followUps.aEn: Prefix "Negative" and convert the absolute value; −2^63 overflows when negated, so widen or go unsigned first. Larger numbers only need more scale words such as Trillion and Quadrillion.

followUps.qZh: 哪些地方最容易错？
followUps.qEn: What goes wrong most often?
followUps.aZh: 0 要单独处理；11 到 19 是特殊词；全 0 的组（比如 1,000,010 中间的 000）不能输出单位；单词之间只留一个空格，末尾不留空格。
followUps.aEn: Zero needs its own case; 11 to 19 are special words; an all-zero group (the middle 000 of 1,000,010) gets no scale word; words are separated by single spaces with none at the end.

lc-283.takeawayZh: 稳定地「挑出一类元素」：写指针收下要留的，最后统一填尾巴；或者交换，让零自然沉到后面。
lc-283.takeawayEn: Stably pulling out one kind of element: the write pointer takes what stays and the tail is filled at the end, or swap so the zeros sink back on their own.

followUps.qZh: 怎样让写操作尽量少？
followUps.qEn: How do you minimise writes?
followUps.aZh: 用交换的写法：快指针遇到非零数就和慢指针位置交换，并且只在两个指针不同时才交换。没有零的数组一次写都不会发生。
followUps.aEn: Use the swap version: when the fast pointer meets a non-zero, swap it with the slow pointer, and only when the two differ. An array without zeros causes no writes at all.

followUps.qZh: 改成把所有等于 val 的元素移到末尾，其余保持顺序？
followUps.qEn: Move every element equal to val to the end, keeping the rest in order?
followUps.aZh: 判断条件从「非零」换成「不等于 val」，还是同一个读写指针模板。只要求删掉、不要求放到末尾时，就是移除元素那道题。
followUps.aEn: Change the test from "non-zero" to "not equal to val"; it is the same read/write template. If val only needs removing, it becomes Remove Element.

lc-287.takeawayZh: 值域 [1, n] 的数组可以看成函数图 i → nums[i]。「重复」就是两条边指向同一个点，也就是环的入口。
lc-287.takeawayEn: An array with values in [1, n] is a functional graph i → nums[i]. A duplicate is two edges into one node, which is exactly the entrance of the cycle.

followUps.qZh: 为什么能看成链表找环？
followUps.qEn: Why can it be treated as finding a cycle in a linked list?
followUps.aZh: 把 i → nums[i] 看成一条边。值都在 [1, n]，所以没有边指向下标 0，从 0 出发一定会走进环；环的入口被两个下标指向，那个值就是重复数。
followUps.aEn: Treat i → nums[i] as an edge. Values lie in [1, n], so nothing points at index 0, and a walk from 0 must enter a cycle; its entrance is pointed to by two indices, and that value is the duplicate.

followUps.qZh: 二分值域的做法依据是什么？
followUps.qEn: What justifies binary searching on the values?
followUps.aZh: 统计 ≤ mid 的数有 cnt 个。若 cnt > mid，[1, mid] 里一定挤进了重复数（鸽巢原理），往左找；否则往右。O(n log n) 时间，不改数组。
followUps.aEn: Count the cnt numbers ≤ mid. If cnt > mid, the duplicate must be in [1, mid] by pigeonhole, so go left; otherwise go right. O(n log n) time without touching the array.

lc-324.takeawayZh: 严格摆动的关键是让相等的值离得足够远：较小的一半和较大的一半各自倒序，再交错放。
lc-324.takeawayEn: A strict wiggle needs equal values far apart: reverse the smaller half and the larger half, then interleave them.

followUps.qZh: 如果只要求 nums[0] ≤ nums[1] ≥ nums[2] ≤ …（允许相等）？
followUps.qEn: What if equality is allowed: nums[0] ≤ nums[1] ≥ nums[2] ≤ …?
followUps.aZh: 一遍贪心就够：奇数位置比下一个小就交换，偶数位置比下一个大就交换。O(n)，不需要排序。
followUps.aEn: One greedy pass: swap when an odd index is smaller than the next or an even index is larger than the next. O(n), no sorting.

followUps.qZh: 为什么要把两半倒序再穿插？
followUps.qEn: Why reverse both halves before interleaving?
followUps.aZh: 正序穿插时，中位数附近的相同值可能落到相邻位置。比如 [4,5,5,6]：正序得到 [4,5,5,6]，两个 5 相邻；倒序得到 [5,6,4,5]，满足要求。
followUps.aEn: Interleaving in order can put copies of the median next to each other. For [4,5,5,6], in order gives [4,5,5,6] with the 5s adjacent; reversed gives [5,6,4,5], which works.

lc-334.takeawayZh: 只问「存不存在」时，维护「每个长度的递增子序列的最小结尾」就够了。
lc-334.takeawayEn: When you only ask whether one exists, keep the smallest ending of an increasing run of each length.

followUps.qZh: 改成长度为 k 的递增子序列是否存在？
followUps.qEn: Does an increasing subsequence of length k exist?
followUps.aZh: 维护 k−1 个「长度为 j 的递增子序列的最小结尾」，每个数二分找到要替换的位置，O(n log k)。这正是最长递增子序列的贪心加二分。
followUps.aEn: Keep k−1 smallest endings for each length j and binary search where each number goes, O(n log k). That is the greedy-plus-binary-search for the longest increasing subsequence.

followUps.qZh: first 被后面更小的值替换后，为什么答案还对？
followUps.qEn: Why is it still correct after first is replaced by a later, smaller value?
followUps.aZh: second 存在就说明它前面曾经有过比它小的数。first 变小只影响以后能不能形成新的二元组，不会让已有的 second 失效。
followUps.aEn: second existing already proves a smaller value came before it. A smaller first only affects future pairs; it never invalidates the current second.

lc-336.takeawayZh: 两段拼成回文就枚举切分点：一边是回文，另一边反转后必须是另一个单词。
lc-336.takeawayEn: Two pieces forming a palindrome: try every split point; one side must be a palindrome and the reverse of the other must be another word.

followUps.qZh: 空串要怎么处理？
followUps.qEn: How do you handle the empty string?
followUps.aZh: 空串和任何本身是回文的单词，两种顺序都能拼成回文。按切分点枚举时，切在开头或末尾正好覆盖这种情况，但要避免同一对被算两次。
followUps.aEn: The empty string pairs both ways with every palindromic word. Splitting at the very start or end covers it, but avoid counting the same pair twice.

followUps.qZh: 能不能用字典树？
followUps.qEn: Could a trie help?
followUps.aZh: 把所有单词反转后插入字典树，每个节点记下「从这里往下剩余部分是回文」的单词。逐个单词在树上走，走完或经过某个单词的结尾时检查剩下的部分。复杂度仍是 O(n·k²)，但不需要哈希、常数更小。
followUps.aEn: Insert every reversed word into a trie and store at each node the words whose remainder below it is a palindrome. Walk each word down the trie and check the rest whenever it ends or passes a word end. Still O(n·k²), but no hashing and a smaller constant.

lc-340.takeawayZh: 种类数约束的窗口：某个字符的计数降到 0 时种类数减一，这是左端可以停下的信号。
lc-340.takeawayEn: Windows constrained by kinds: when a count drops to 0 the kind counter decreases, and that is where the left end can stop.

followUps.qZh: 数据是一个流，不能回头读呢？
followUps.qEn: What if the input is a stream you cannot reread?
followUps.aZh: 维护每个字符最后出现的位置（按位置有序，比如 LinkedHashMap 或有序表）。种类超过 k 时，删掉最后出现位置最靠左的那个，左端跳到它之后；不需要回头读原数据。
followUps.aEn: Keep each character's last position in position order (a LinkedHashMap or an ordered map). With more than k kinds, drop the one seen least recently and move the left end past it; no rereading is needed.

followUps.qZh: 改成恰好 k 种的子串个数？
followUps.qEn: Count substrings with exactly k kinds?
followUps.aZh: 恰好 k 种 = 最多 k 种 − 最多 k−1 种，两者都能用滑动窗口按右端计数。
followUps.aEn: Exactly k equals at most k minus at most k−1, and both are counted per right end with a sliding window.

lc-344.takeawayZh: 原地反转：两端指针交换，向中间收拢，相遇就停。
lc-344.takeawayEn: Reversing in place: swap at both ends, move inward, stop when they meet.

followUps.qZh: 字符串含有 emoji 或带声调的组合字符时，逐个字符反转会怎样？
followUps.qEn: What happens with emoji or combining accents if you reverse unit by unit?
followUps.aZh: 代理对和组合符号会被拆开，结果变成乱码。要先按「字形簇」切分再反转；面试里至少要能指出这个风险。
followUps.aEn: Surrogate pairs and combining marks get split and the result is garbled. Split into grapheme clusters first, then reverse; at least name the risk in an interview.

followUps.qZh: 用递归写，代价是什么？
followUps.qEn: What does a recursive version cost?
followUps.aZh: reverse(l, r)：交换两端，再递归处理 (l+1, r−1)。逻辑一样，但要 O(n) 的栈深度，n = 10^5 时容易栈溢出，不如循环。
followUps.aEn: reverse(l, r) swaps the ends and recurses on (l+1, r−1). Same logic, but O(n) stack depth, which can overflow at n = 10^5; a loop is better.

lc-345.takeawayZh: 「只处理一部分字符」的反转：两端指针各自跳过不相关的字符，再交换。
lc-345.takeawayEn: Reversing only some characters: each pointer skips the irrelevant ones, then they swap.

followUps.qZh: 改成只反转字母，其余字符位置不动？
followUps.qEn: Reverse only the letters, keeping everything else in place?
followUps.aZh: 同一个模板，把「是不是元音」换成「是不是字母」。
followUps.aEn: Same template; replace "is a vowel" with "is a letter".

followUps.qZh: 元音判断怎么写才不容易漏？
followUps.qEn: How do you test for vowels without missing any?
followUps.aZh: 用一个包含大小写共 10 个元音的集合查表。只写小写会漏掉 "A"、"E" 这样的大写元音。
followUps.aEn: Look up a set of all ten vowels in both cases. Listing only lowercase misses uppercase vowels such as "A" and "E".

lc-350.takeawayZh: 多重集合的交集就是「计数相消」：用一方建计数表，另一方逐个消耗。输入有序时换成双指针，内存紧时让小的一方进内存。
lc-350.takeawayEn: A multiset intersection is counting and cancelling: count one side, consume with the other. When sorted, use two pointers; when memory is tight, keep the smaller side in memory.

followUps.qZh: 如果两个数组都已经排好序？
followUps.qEn: What if both arrays are already sorted?
followUps.aZh: 双指针：较小的那边前进，相等时记下并同时前进。O(m + n) 时间，除输出外 O(1) 空间。
followUps.aEn: Two pointers: advance the smaller side, and on equality record it and advance both. O(m + n) time and O(1) space besides the output.

followUps.qZh: nums1 很小、nums2 很大时怎么选？
followUps.qEn: What if nums1 is small and nums2 is huge?
followUps.aZh: 用小的 nums1 建计数表，遍历 nums2 消耗计数，哈希表只占 O(min(m, n))。
followUps.aEn: Build the count table from the small nums1 and stream nums2 against it; the table takes only O(min(m, n)).

followUps.qZh: nums2 存在磁盘上，内存放不下呢？
followUps.qEn: What if nums2 lives on disk and does not fit in memory?
followUps.aZh: 小数组的计数表留在内存，nums2 分块读入逐块消耗。两边都放不下时，先各自外部排序，再用双指针流式合并。
followUps.aEn: Keep the small side's counts in memory and read nums2 in chunks. If neither fits, sort both externally, then merge the two streams with two pointers.

lc-395.takeawayZh: 条件没有单调性时，先固定一个参数（这里是字符种类数），把单调性造出来。
lc-395.takeawayEn: When the condition is not monotone, fix one parameter (here the number of distinct letters) to create monotonicity.

followUps.qZh: 为什么普通的滑动窗口不行？
followUps.qEn: Why does a plain sliding window fail?
followUps.aZh: 窗口变长不一定让条件变好（新字符可能只出现一次），变短也不一定变差，没有单调性。固定「窗口里恰好 t 种字符」后才有单调性，再枚举 t = 1..26。
followUps.aEn: Growing may not help (a new letter may appear once) and shrinking may not hurt, so there is no monotonicity. Fixing "exactly t distinct letters in the window" restores it; then try t = 1..26.

followUps.qZh: 分治的切分点怎么选？
followUps.qEn: Where does divide and conquer split?
followUps.aZh: 整个串里出现次数少于 k 的字符不可能在答案里，用它们把串切开，分别递归；没有这样的字符时，整个串就是答案。
followUps.aEn: A letter occurring fewer than k times in the whole string cannot be in the answer, so split there and recurse; with no such letter, the whole string is the answer.

lc-409.takeawayZh: 回文的计数视角：成对的字符左右各放一个，最多一个字符放在正中间。
lc-409.takeawayEn: Counting view of a palindrome: paired characters go one on each side, and at most one sits in the middle.

followUps.qZh: 要把这个最长回文串构造出来？
followUps.qEn: Build the longest palindrome itself?
followUps.aZh: 每个字符取 ⌊cnt/2⌋ 个组成左半，左半反转作右半；有出现奇数次的字符，就任选一个放在正中间。
followUps.aEn: Take ⌊cnt/2⌋ of each character for the left half and mirror it for the right; if any character occurs an odd number of times, put one of them in the middle.

followUps.qZh: 只问整个字符串能不能重排成回文？
followUps.qEn: Only ask whether the whole string can be rearranged into a palindrome?
followUps.aZh: 出现奇数次的字符不超过一个即可。
followUps.aEn: Yes exactly when at most one character occurs an odd number of times.

lc-424.takeawayZh: 窗口合法的条件是「长度 − 出现最多的字符次数 ≤ k」；只求最长时，窗口可以只变长、不变短。
lc-424.takeawayEn: A window is valid when length minus the top count is at most k; when only the maximum matters, the window can grow and never shrink.

followUps.qZh: 为什么历史最大次数 maxf 收缩时不用减小？
followUps.qEn: Why need maxf never decrease when the window shrinks?
followUps.aZh: 答案只有在 maxf 变大时才可能变大。长度 − maxf > k 时，窗口只是整体右移一位，长度不变；maxf 偏大只会让窗口保持当前长度，不会产生错误的更长答案。
followUps.aEn: The answer can only grow when maxf grows. When length − maxf > k the window just slides right by one at the same length; a stale maxf keeps the length, it never produces a longer wrong answer.

followUps.qZh: 换成 0/1 数组、最多翻转 k 个 0？
followUps.qEn: For a 0/1 array where at most k zeros may flip?
followUps.aZh: 同一个模板：需要替换的数量就是窗口里 0 的个数。
followUps.aEn: Same template: the replacements needed are the zeros in the window.

lc-438.takeawayZh: 判断窗口是不是某个多重集合：维护差值计数和「已经对上的字母种类数」。
lc-438.takeawayEn: To test a window against a multiset, keep difference counts and the number of letters already matching.

followUps.qZh: 每次都比较 26 个计数太慢？
followUps.qEn: Comparing 26 counts every step is slow?
followUps.aZh: 维护一个「次数已经对上的字母种类数」：进出窗口时只检查变化的那个字母，是刚好对上还是刚好不再对上；种类数等于 26 时就是异位词。每步 O(1)。
followUps.aEn: Track how many letters currently have matching counts; on each move only the changed letter can start or stop matching. When all 26 match, it is an anagram. O(1) per step.

followUps.qZh: 只问存不存在，不要所有位置？
followUps.qEn: Only ask whether one exists?
followUps.aZh: 找到第一个就返回，就是「字符串的排列」那道题。
followUps.aEn: Return at the first match; that is the Permutation in String problem.

lc-442.takeawayZh: 原地标记时「翻之前已经是负数」就说明重复。改数组之前先问一句：能改吗？
lc-442.takeawayEn: With in-place marking, a slot that is already negative means a repeat. Before modifying the array, ask whether you may.

followUps.qZh: 有的数可能出现三次或更多呢？
followUps.qEn: What if some numbers appear three or more times?
followUps.aZh: 正负号只能记「见过没见过」。可以改成每见到值 v 就给 `nums[v-1]` 加 n，最后用 `nums[i] // n` 得到出现次数，仍是 O(1) 额外空间；Java 和 C++ 里要注意加完后的值会不会超出 int。
followUps.aEn: A sign only records seen or not. Add n to `nums[v-1]` for every v instead, and read counts as `nums[i] // n`, still O(1) extra space; in Java and C++ check that the sums still fit in an int.

followUps.qZh: 不能修改数组时怎么办？
followUps.qEn: What if the array is read-only?
followUps.aZh: 用哈希集合，O(n) 空间。如果只有一个重复值、又不能改数组，就是快慢指针找环的那道题。
followUps.aEn: Use a hash set, O(n) space. With exactly one repeated value and a read-only array, it becomes the cycle-detection problem.

lc-448.takeawayZh: 值域是 [1, n] 时，数组下标本身就是哈希表：用正负号标记「这个值出现过」。
lc-448.takeawayEn: When values lie in [1, n], the indices are the hash table: flip a sign to mark that a value was seen.

followUps.qZh: 如果不允许修改输入数组？
followUps.qEn: What if the input must not be modified?
followUps.aZh: 原地标记就不能用了。用一个长度 n 的布尔数组（O(n) 空间），或者复制一份排序后找缺口。
followUps.aEn: In-place marking is out. Use a boolean array of length n (O(n) space), or sort a copy and look for gaps.

followUps.qZh: 同时找出出现了两次的数？
followUps.qEn: Also find the numbers that appear twice?
followUps.aZh: 同一遍标记里，要去翻的位置如果已经是负数，说明这个值是第二次出现。
followUps.aEn: In the same marking pass, if the slot you are about to flip is already negative, this value is appearing a second time.

lc-454.takeawayZh: 折半（meet in the middle）：把 n⁴ 拆成两个 n²，一半存成计数表，另一半去查补数。
lc-454.takeawayEn: Meet in the middle: split n⁴ into two n² halves, store one as counts and look up complements from the other.

followUps.qZh: 如果是 k 个数组？
followUps.qEn: What about k arrays?
followUps.aZh: 分成前后两半，各自枚举所有组合的和（各 n^(k/2) 个），一半存计数表、另一半查补数，O(n^(k/2))。
followUps.aEn: Split them into two halves, enumerate every sum of each half (n^(k/2) each), count one half and look up complements from the other: O(n^(k/2)).

followUps.qZh: 改成从同一个数组里选四个不同下标，结果按值去重？
followUps.qEn: Pick four distinct indices from one array and list unique value quadruples?
followUps.aZh: 那是四数之和：排序后两层枚举加双指针，O(n³)，每一层都跳过重复值。
followUps.aEn: That is 4Sum: sort, two nested loops and two pointers, O(n³), skipping repeats at every level.

lc-459.takeawayZh: 周期问题想到两件事：s 和它的旋转是什么关系，以及前缀函数给出的最小周期 n − π[n−1]。
lc-459.takeawayEn: For periodicity, think of two things: how s relates to its rotations, and the minimal period n − π[n−1] from the prefix function.

followUps.qZh: 为什么「s 出现在 (s+s) 去掉首尾字符之后」就说明能重复构成？
followUps.qEn: Why does finding s inside (s+s) minus its first and last characters prove it repeats?
followUps.aZh: 去掉首尾字符正好排除了位置 0 和 n 两个平凡的匹配。若 s 在中间位置 k 出现，说明 s 旋转 k 位后不变，于是 s 有周期 gcd(k, n)：它整除 n 且小于 n。反过来，有这样的周期就一定能在中间找到 s。
followUps.aEn: Dropping the ends removes the trivial matches at 0 and n. A match at k in between means s equals its rotation by k, so s has period gcd(k, n), which divides n and is less than n. Conversely, such a period always yields a middle match.

followUps.qZh: 要返回最短的重复单元？
followUps.qEn: Return the shortest repeating unit?
followUps.aZh: 用前缀函数：p = n − π[n−1]。若 p < n 且 n 能被 p 整除，最短单元就是 s[0:p]，否则不存在。
followUps.aEn: With the prefix function, p = n − π[n−1]. If p < n and p divides n, the unit is s[0:p]; otherwise there is none.

lc-554.takeawayZh: 「穿过的砖最少」就是「对齐的缝最多」：反过来数最常见的缝位置。
lc-554.takeawayEn: Crossing the fewest bricks means lining up with the most gaps: count the most common gap position instead.

followUps.qZh: 为什么不统计每行最右边的那条缝？
followUps.qEn: Why skip the rightmost edge of each row?
followUps.aZh: 墙的右边界不算缝，线画在边界上等于没穿过墙。只统计每行最后一块砖之前的累计宽度。
followUps.aEn: The wall's right edge is not a gap; a line there would not cross the wall. Count prefix widths only before each row's last brick.

followUps.qZh: 墙宽到 2^31−1，能不能按宽度开数组？
followUps.qEn: With widths up to 2^31−1, can you index an array by position?
followUps.aZh: 不能。用哈希表只存实际出现过的缝位置，大小不超过砖块总数。每行宽度不超过 2^31−1，累计宽度用 32 位整数就够。
followUps.aEn: No. A hash map stores only the gap positions that occur, at most the number of bricks. Each row is at most 2^31−1 wide, so 32-bit prefix sums suffice.

lc-567.takeawayZh: 定长窗口比较多重集合：窗口长度固定为 |s1|，进一个、出一个，只更新变化的字母。
lc-567.takeawayEn: Fixed-size multiset comparison: the window is |s1| long, one letter in and one out, updating only the changed letters.

followUps.qZh: 字符集是任意 Unicode 时？
followUps.qEn: What if the alphabet is any Unicode?
followUps.aZh: 计数数组换成哈希表；「已经对上的种类数」的维护方式不变。
followUps.aEn: Swap the count array for a hash map; tracking the number of matching letters stays the same.

followUps.qZh: 要返回所有匹配的位置？
followUps.qEn: Return every matching position?
followUps.aZh: 找到后不要返回，继续滑动，把每个匹配的起点记下来。
followUps.aEn: Do not stop at the first; keep sliding and record every starting index.

lc-645.takeawayZh: 「一个重复、一个缺失」有两个未知数，就要两个方程：和与平方和，或者异或之后按某一位分组。
lc-645.takeawayEn: One duplicate and one missing value are two unknowns, so you need two equations: the sum and the sum of squares, or XOR and then split by one bit.

followUps.qZh: 用异或能做到 O(1) 空间吗？
followUps.qEn: Can XOR do it in O(1) space?
followUps.aZh: 把数组里的数和 1..n 一起异或，得到 `dup ^ missing`。按它最低位的 1 把所有数分成两组分别异或，得到两个数；再扫一遍数组，出现过的是重复值。
followUps.aEn: XOR the array together with 1..n to get `dup ^ missing`. Split all numbers by its lowest set bit and XOR each group to get the two values; one more scan tells which one occurs in the array.

followUps.qZh: 数学法会不会溢出？
followUps.qEn: Can the math approach overflow?
followUps.aZh: 会。n = 10^4 时平方和约为 3.3×10^11，超出 32 位；Java 和 C++ 要用 long。
followUps.aEn: Yes. For n = 10^4 the sum of squares is about 3.3×10^11, beyond 32 bits; use long in Java and C++.

lc-680.takeawayZh: 带一次容错的双指针：第一次失配时分两路各试一次，之后不能再错。
lc-680.takeawayEn: Two pointers with one allowed fault: at the first mismatch try both branches once, and allow no further mismatch.

followUps.qZh: 最多允许删除 k 个字符呢？
followUps.qEn: What if up to k deletions are allowed?
followUps.aZh: 分支会指数增长，贪心不再可靠。改成求「最少删几个字符变成回文」= n − 最长回文子序列的长度，区间 DP O(n²)，结果 ≤ k 即可。
followUps.aEn: Branching grows exponentially, so greedy no longer works. Compute the fewest deletions instead, n minus the longest palindromic subsequence, with interval DP in O(n²), and compare with k.

followUps.qZh: 为什么失配时只要试删左边或右边这两种？
followUps.qEn: Why only try deleting the left or the right character at a mismatch?
followUps.aZh: 失配之前两端已经配好。要成为回文，失配的这一对里至少要删掉一个；删别处的字符解决不了这一对的不匹配。
followUps.aEn: Everything outside already matches. To become a palindrome, one of the mismatched pair must go; deleting anything else cannot fix this pair.

lc-686.takeawayZh: 「重复若干次后包含」：先界定次数的上限，再变成普通的子串匹配。
lc-686.takeawayEn: "Contains after repeating": bound the number of copies first, then it is ordinary substring search.

followUps.qZh: 为什么最多只要试 ⌈m/n⌉ + 1 份？
followUps.qEn: Why is ⌈m/n⌉ + 1 copies always enough to try?
followUps.aZh: b 若能出现，起点一定可以落在第一份 a 里（0 到 n−1）。从那里覆盖 m 个字符最多跨 ⌈m/n⌉ + 1 份，再多重复只是把同样的起点再试一遍。
followUps.aEn: If b occurs, some occurrence starts inside the first copy of a (0 to n−1). Covering m characters from there spans at most ⌈m/n⌉ + 1 copies; more copies only retry the same starts.

followUps.qZh: 怎么避免真的拼出一个很长的字符串？
followUps.qEn: How do you avoid building the long string?
followUps.aZh: 把 a 当作循环文本，用 i mod n 取字符，直接在上面跑 KMP；只需检查起点落在第一份 a 里的匹配。
followUps.aEn: Treat a as cyclic text, reading index i mod n, and run KMP on it directly; only matches starting in the first copy matter.

lc-713.takeawayZh: 以右端为准计数：每个右端贡献「窗口长度」个以它结尾的子数组。
lc-713.takeawayEn: Count by right end: each right end contributes as many subarrays as the window is long.

followUps.qZh: 为什么 k ≤ 1 要特判？
followUps.qEn: Why special-case k ≤ 1?
followUps.aZh: 所有元素都 ≥ 1，乘积至少是 1，不可能严格小于 1；不特判的话左端会越过右端。
followUps.aEn: Every element is at least 1, so no product is below 1; without the check the left end runs past the right.

followUps.qZh: 乘积会溢出吗？
followUps.qEn: Can the product overflow?
followUps.aZh: 窗口乘积一旦 ≥ k 就收缩，所以乘新元素之前乘积 < k ≤ 10^6，乘上 ≤ 1000 的值后小于 10^9，32 位够用。值域或 k 更大时要用 64 位，或者改用对数（注意精度）。
followUps.aEn: The window shrinks once the product reaches k, so before multiplying it is below k ≤ 10^6, and after it stays under 10^9, which fits 32 bits. With larger values or k, use 64 bits or logarithms, minding precision.

lc-796.takeawayZh: 旋转问题都可以放到 s+s 里看：s 的所有旋转，都是 s+s 里长度为 n 的子串。
lc-796.takeawayEn: Rotations live inside s+s: every rotation of s is a length-n substring of s+s.

followUps.qZh: 为什么一定要先比较长度？
followUps.qEn: Why compare lengths first?
followUps.aZh: 只检查 goal 在不在 s+s 里，s = "ab"、goal = "a" 也会返回 true。长度相等才说明 goal 是一个完整的旋转。
followUps.aEn: Checking only that goal occurs in s+s would accept s = "ab", goal = "a". Equal lengths make it a whole rotation.

followUps.qZh: 要返回最少旋转几位？
followUps.qEn: Return the smallest number of rotations?
followUps.aZh: 在 s+s 里找 goal 第一次出现的位置 k（0 ≤ k < n），就是左移 k 位；用 KMP 可以做到 O(n)。
followUps.aEn: Find the first occurrence k of goal in s+s (0 ≤ k < n); that is k left rotations, O(n) with KMP.

lc-809.takeawayZh: 处理「连续相同的字符」时先做游程编码：比较的是一段一段，而不是单个字符。
lc-809.takeawayEn: For runs of equal characters, run-length encode first: compare runs, not single characters.

followUps.qZh: 拉伸的阈值不是 3，而是 k？
followUps.qEn: What if the stretch threshold is k instead of 3?
followUps.aZh: 条件换成：两段字符相同，并且 s 的段长等于 word 的段长，或者 s 的段长 ≥ max(k, word 的段长)。
followUps.aEn: Require the same character and either equal run lengths or an s run of at least max(k, the word's run).

followUps.qZh: 先把字符串压成 (字符, 次数) 列表再比，可以吗？
followUps.qEn: Could you compress both into (char, count) lists first?
followUps.aZh: 可以。s 和 word 各做一次游程编码，比较段数和每一段，代码更清楚，复杂度相同。
followUps.aEn: Yes. Run-length encode s and each word, compare the number of runs and each run; the code is clearer at the same cost.

lc-844.takeawayZh: 删除影响的是前面的字符时，倒着扫就能马上知道当前字符会不会被删。
lc-844.takeawayEn: When a deletion affects earlier characters, scanning backward tells at once whether the current one survives.

followUps.qZh: 能做到 O(1) 额外空间吗？
followUps.qEn: Can it run in O(1) extra space?
followUps.aZh: 从后往前扫，用计数器记下还要跳过几个字符：遇到 "#" 加一，遇到字母且计数大于 0 就跳过并减一。两个串各自找到下一个有效字符再比较。
followUps.aEn: Scan from the back with a skip counter: "#" adds one, and a letter with a positive counter is skipped and decrements it. Find the next surviving character in each string and compare.

followUps.qZh: 如果还有一个清空整行的按键（比如 "@"）？
followUps.qEn: What if a key such as "@" clears the whole line?
followUps.aZh: 倒着扫时遇到 "@"，它前面的内容全部作废，这一串就不用再往前扫了；剩下的有效字符就是 "@" 之后已经扫过的部分。
followUps.aEn: Scanning backward, an "@" voids everything before it, so that string stops there; its surviving characters are those already scanned after the "@".

lc-904.takeawayZh: 先把题目翻译成「满足某条件的最长连续子数组」，再套窗口模板。
lc-904.takeawayEn: Translate the story into "the longest contiguous subarray satisfying a condition" first, then apply the window template.

followUps.qZh: 篮子变成 k 个？
followUps.qEn: What if there are k baskets?
followUps.aZh: 就是「最多 k 种不同元素的最长子数组」，同一个窗口模板。
followUps.aEn: It becomes the longest subarray with at most k distinct values, the same window template.

followUps.qZh: 为什么摘到的一定是连续的一段？
followUps.qEn: Why is the picked range always contiguous?
followUps.aZh: 从某棵树开始只能一直往右摘，碰到第三种就停，所以摘到的是一段连续区间，条件是其中最多两种值。
followUps.aEn: You start at some tree and keep moving right until a third kind appears, so the picked trees form a contiguous range with at most two values.

lc-912.takeawayZh: 选排序算法先问三件事：要不要稳定，额外空间能给多少，最坏情况能不能接受。
lc-912.takeawayEn: Before picking a sort, ask three things: must it be stable, how much extra space is allowed, and is the worst case acceptable.

followUps.qZh: 快速排序遇到大量重复值或已经有序的输入会怎样？
followUps.qEn: What happens to quicksort on sorted or duplicate-heavy input?
followUps.aZh: 固定选第一个元素做 pivot，在有序输入上会退化到 O(n²)。随机选 pivot，再用三路划分处理重复值，期望 O(n log n)。
followUps.aEn: Always pivoting on the first element degrades to O(n²) on sorted input. Pick a random pivot and partition three ways for duplicates: expected O(n log n).

followUps.qZh: 需要稳定排序时选哪个？
followUps.qEn: Which one when the sort must be stable?
followUps.aZh: 归并排序是稳定的，代价是 O(n) 额外空间；堆排序和常见的快速排序都不稳定。
followUps.aEn: Merge sort is stable at the cost of O(n) extra space; heap sort and the usual quicksort are not.

followUps.qEn: With values only in [−5×10^4, 5×10^4], is there something faster?
followUps.aZh: 计数排序：O(n + 值域)。这里值域约 10^5，和 n 同一个量级，可以线性完成。
followUps.aEn: Counting sort, O(n + range). The range here is about 10^5, the same order as n, so it runs in linear time.

lc-917.takeawayZh: 反转一个子集：先确定哪些字符参与，指针跳过其余的，交换参与的字符。
lc-917.takeawayEn: Reversing a subset: decide which characters take part, let the pointers skip the rest, and swap the ones that do.

followUps.qZh: 改成每个单词内部反转、单词顺序不变？
followUps.qEn: Reverse each word internally but keep the word order?
followUps.aZh: 按分隔符切出每个单词，单词内部用双指针反转；或者一遍扫描，遇到单词边界就反转刚结束的那一段。
followUps.aEn: Split at the separators and reverse each word with two pointers, or scan once and reverse each word as it ends.

followUps.qZh: 怎么判断「字母」？
followUps.qEn: How should you test for a letter?
followUps.aZh: Python 的 str.isalpha() 对 é 这类非 ASCII 字母也返回 True。题目只有 ASCII，直接比较 a–z、A–Z 的范围最稳。
followUps.aEn: Python's str.isalpha() is also True for non-ASCII letters such as é. With ASCII input, comparing against a–z and A–Z is the safest test.

lc-977.takeawayZh: 有序数组经过「先降后升」的变换后，最大值一定在两端：从后往前填。
lc-977.takeawayEn: After a decreasing-then-increasing transform of a sorted array, the largest values sit at the ends: fill from the back.

followUps.qZh: 平方之后还要去重？
followUps.qEn: Also remove duplicate squares?
followUps.aZh: 双指针从两端取较大的平方时，如果和上一个写入的值相等就跳过。
followUps.aEn: When taking the larger square from the ends, skip it if it equals the value written last.

followUps.qZh: 换成任意二次函数 f(x) = ax² + bx + c？
followUps.qEn: What about any quadratic f(x) = ax² + bx + c?
followUps.aZh: a > 0 时最大值在两端，从后往前填；a < 0 时最小值在两端，从前往后填；a = 0 时是单调函数，按 b 的符号正序或倒序输出。
followUps.aEn: For a > 0 the largest values are at the ends, so fill from the back; for a < 0 the smallest are, so fill from the front; for a = 0 it is monotone, ascending or reversed by the sign of b.

lc-992.takeawayZh: 「恰好 k」=「至多 k」−「至多 k−1」，把不单调的计数拆成两个单调的。
lc-992.takeawayEn: "Exactly k" is "at most k" minus "at most k−1": two monotone counts replace one that is not.

followUps.qZh: 为什么「恰好 k」不能直接用一个窗口？
followUps.qEn: Why can one window not count "exactly k" directly?
followUps.aZh: 固定右端时，满足「恰好 k 种」的左端是一段区间，而不是一个点，一个窗口只能维护一个左端。用「最多 k 种」减「最多 k−1 种」就得到了这段区间的长度。
followUps.aEn: For a fixed right end, the valid left ends form a range, not a point, and one window tracks a single left end. "At most k" minus "at most k−1" gives the length of that range.

followUps.qZh: 能不能一次扫描？
followUps.qEn: Can it be done in one pass?
followUps.aZh: 可以：同时维护两个左端，一个是「最多 k 种」的最左位置，一个是「最多 k−1 种」的最左位置，每个右端贡献两者之差。
followUps.aEn: Yes: keep two left ends, the leftmost for "at most k" and the leftmost for "at most k−1"; each right end contributes their difference.

lc-1004.takeawayZh: 把「可以改 k 次」看成预算：窗口里需要改的数量不超过预算，窗口就合法。
lc-1004.takeawayEn: Treat "k changes" as a budget: a window is valid while what it needs changed fits the budget.

followUps.qZh: 如果必须删除恰好一个元素（不是翻转）？
followUps.qEn: What if exactly one element must be deleted instead?
followUps.aZh: 窗口里最多一个 0，答案是窗口长度减 1（删掉的那个）。
followUps.aEn: The window holds at most one 0 and the answer is its length minus 1, for the deleted element.

followUps.qZh: 数据是一个流、k 很小呢？
followUps.qEn: What if the data is a stream and k is small?
followUps.aZh: 用一个队列记下窗口里 0 的位置；超过 k 个时，左端跳到最早那个 0 之后，不需要存整个数组。
followUps.aEn: Keep a queue of the zero positions in the window; with more than k, move the left end past the oldest one. The whole array never needs storing.

lc-1010.takeawayZh: 「和能被 k 整除」就是余数互补；余数 0 和 k/2 是和自己配对的特例。
lc-1010.takeawayEn: "Sum divisible by k" means complementary remainders; remainders 0 and k/2 pair with themselves.

followUps.qZh: 改成和能被任意 k 整除？
followUps.qEn: Generalise to any k?
followUps.aZh: 同样按余数计数：余数 r 和 (k − r) % k 配对。r = 0，以及 k 为偶数时的 r = k/2，要和自己配对，个数是 C(cnt, 2)。
followUps.aEn: Count by remainder the same way: r pairs with (k − r) % k. r = 0, and r = k/2 when k is even, pair with themselves, giving C(cnt, 2).

followUps.qZh: 改成子数组的和能被 k 整除？
followUps.qEn: What about subarrays whose sum is divisible by k?
followUps.aZh: 那要对前缀和取余数，再数余数相同的前缀对。
followUps.aEn: Then take prefix sums modulo k and count pairs of prefixes with the same remainder.

lc-1023.takeawayZh: 带约束的子序列匹配：双指针扫描 query，能匹配就推进 pattern；不能跳过的字符（这里是大写字母）一出现就失败。
lc-1023.takeawayEn: Subsequence matching with a constraint: scan the query with two pointers, advancing the pattern on a match; any character that may not be skipped (an uppercase letter here) fails at once.

followUps.qZh: 如果允许插入任意字符，不只小写字母？
followUps.qEn: What if any character may be inserted, not only lowercase?
followUps.aZh: 那就只是判断 pattern 是不是 query 的子序列，去掉「遇到多余大写字母就失败」这条检查即可。
followUps.aEn: Then it is plain subsequence testing; drop the rule that an extra uppercase letter fails.

followUps.qZh: 有很多 pattern，要判断一个 query 能匹配哪些？
followUps.qEn: With many patterns, which ones does a query match?
followUps.aZh: 逐个 pattern 跑双指针是 O(|query|·P)。pattern 很多时，可以把它们建成字典树，用 query 在树上走，维护「当前可能所在的节点」集合：小写字母既可以沿边走，也可以留在原地；大写字母必须沿边走。最后落在某个 pattern 结尾的节点，就是匹配上的。
followUps.aEn: Running two pointers per pattern costs O(|query|·P). With many patterns, put them in a trie and walk it with the query, keeping the set of nodes you could be at: a lowercase letter may follow an edge or stay put, an uppercase one must follow an edge. Nodes that end a pattern at the finish are the matches.

lc-1044.takeawayZh: 「有长度 L 的答案，就有更短的」这种单调性，提示对长度二分。
lc-1044.takeawayEn: Monotonicity ("a repeat of length L implies shorter ones") is the cue to binary search on the length.

followUps.qZh: 哈希碰撞怎么处理？
followUps.qEn: How do you handle hash collisions?
followUps.aZh: 用两个不同的模数做双哈希，降低碰撞概率；或者哈希相同时再比较原始子串确认。只用一个哈希又不验证，可能被特意构造的数据卡掉。
followUps.aEn: Use two moduli (a double hash) to make collisions unlikely, or confirm by comparing the substrings on a hash match. A single unverified hash can be broken by crafted data.

followUps.qZh: 有没有不依赖哈希的做法？
followUps.qEn: Is there a method without hashing?
followUps.aZh: 后缀数组加 LCP 数组：最长重复子串就是相邻后缀最长公共前缀的最大值，构造 O(n log n)。后缀自动机也可以做。
followUps.aEn: A suffix array with its LCP array: the answer is the largest common prefix of adjacent suffixes, built in O(n log n). A suffix automaton works too.

lc-1052.takeawayZh: 「原本就有的」和「操作带来的增量」分开算，增量那部分往往就是一个定长窗口。
lc-1052.takeawayEn: Separate what you already have from what the operation adds; the added part is often a fixed-size window.

followUps.qZh: 为什么把本来就满意的顾客和窗口的额外收益分开算？
followUps.qEn: Why count the always-satisfied customers separately?
followUps.aZh: 不生气的分钟无论窗口放在哪都算；窗口只改变生气的分钟。分开后，答案 = 固定部分 + 定长窗口里「生气时的顾客数」的最大值，不会重复计算。
followUps.aEn: Calm minutes count wherever the window goes; the window only changes grumpy minutes. So the answer is the fixed part plus the best fixed-size window of grumpy customers, with nothing counted twice.

followUps.qZh: 如果技巧可以用两次（两段不重叠）？
followUps.qEn: What if the technique can be used twice, without overlap?
followUps.aZh: 先算「以每个位置结尾或之前的最佳窗口收益」（前缀最大值），再枚举第二个窗口的位置，加上它左边的最佳收益，O(n)。
followUps.aEn: Compute the best window gain ending at or before each position (a prefix maximum), then try every position of the second window plus the best gain to its left. O(n).

lc-1208.takeawayZh: 先把问题变成「非负代价数组上，和不超过预算的最长子数组」。
lc-1208.takeawayEn: Reduce it to the longest subarray of non-negative costs whose sum stays within the budget.

followUps.qZh: 为什么能用滑动窗口？
followUps.qEn: Why does a sliding window work?
followUps.aZh: 每个位置的代价 |s[i] − t[i]| ≥ 0，窗口变长代价不减、变短不增，满足单调性。
followUps.aEn: Each cost |s[i] − t[i]| is non-negative, so growing never lowers the total and shrinking never raises it: the window is monotone.

followUps.qZh: 如果代价可以是负数？
followUps.qEn: What if costs could be negative?
followUps.aZh: 单调性没了，窗口失效。用前缀和：维护前缀和的前缀最大值（单调不减），对每个 r 二分找最左的 l，使它 ≥ P[r] − maxCost，O(n log n)。
followUps.aEn: Monotonicity is gone. Use prefix sums: keep the running maximum of prefix sums (non-decreasing) and, for each r, binary search the leftmost l where it reaches P[r] − maxCost, O(n log n).

lc-1234.takeawayZh: 「替换一段」的题，合法性通常只取决于这段之外剩下什么。
lc-1234.takeawayEn: For "replace one substring" problems, validity usually depends only on what remains outside it.

followUps.qZh: 为什么看的是窗口外的计数？
followUps.qEn: Why look at the counts outside the window?
followUps.aZh: 窗口里的字符可以任意替换，所以只要窗口外每种字符都不超过 n/4，就能把窗口补成平衡。条件只和窗口外有关。
followUps.aEn: Characters inside the window can become anything, so if no letter exceeds n/4 outside it, the window can be filled to balance. Only the outside matters.

followUps.qZh: 改成 k 种字符、每种目标 n/k 个？
followUps.qEn: Generalise to k letters with n/k each?
followUps.aZh: 同样的窗口，检查窗口外每种字符的计数是否都 ≤ n/k。种类多时，维护一个「超标的种类数」计数器，避免每次扫一遍 k 种。
followUps.aEn: Same window: check that every letter outside is at most n/k. With many letters, keep a counter of letters over the limit instead of scanning all k each time.

lc-1328.takeawayZh: 求字典序最小：越靠前的位置影响越大，贪心地改最左边能改的那一位。
lc-1328.takeawayEn: For the lexicographically smallest result, earlier positions matter most: greedily change the leftmost position that can change.

followUps.qZh: 为什么只看前一半？
followUps.qEn: Why only look at the first half?
followUps.aZh: 把前一半某个不是 a 的字符改成 a，既打破了回文，又让字典序变小；改后一半的对应位置字典序反而更大。奇数长度的正中间改了仍是回文，不能用。
followUps.aEn: Changing a non-a in the first half to a breaks the palindrome and makes the string smaller; the mirrored change in the second half would be larger. The middle of an odd length stays a palindrome, so it cannot be used.

followUps.qZh: 改成要字典序最大的非回文？
followUps.qEn: What about the lexicographically largest non-palindrome?
followUps.aZh: 对称地做：前一半第一个不是 z 的字符改成 z；前一半全是 z 时，把最后一个字符改成 y。长度为 1 时同样无解。
followUps.aEn: Mirror it: change the first non-z in the first half to z; if the first half is all z, change the last character to y. Length 1 still has no answer.

lc-1358.takeawayZh: 统计「至少满足」的子串：固定右端，合法的左端是一段前缀，一次加上它的长度。
lc-1358.takeawayEn: Counting "at least" substrings: for a fixed right end, the valid left ends are a prefix; add its length at once.

followUps.qZh: 「最后出现位置」的做法为什么成立？
followUps.qEn: Why does the last-seen method work?
followUps.aZh: 固定右端 r，只要左端 ≤ 三种字符最后出现位置的最小值，子串就包含全部三种；所以以 r 结尾的合法子串个数就是这个最小值 + 1。
followUps.aEn: For right end r, any left end at or before the smallest of the three last-seen positions includes all three letters, so r contributes that minimum plus 1.

followUps.qZh: 改成至少包含 k 种字符（字符集更大）？
followUps.qEn: At least k kinds over a larger alphabet?
followUps.aZh: 窗口计数加种类数：种类数 ≥ k 时就收缩左端，直到刚好不满足；此时左端前面的所有起点都合法，累加左端的位置。
followUps.aEn: Window counts plus a kind counter: while there are at least k kinds, shrink from the left until it just fails; every start before the left end is then valid, so add the left index.

lc-1438.takeawayZh: 窗口里要随时取最值，就配一个单调队列；最大最小都要，就配两个。
lc-1438.takeawayEn: If the window needs its extreme at any time, pair it with a monotonic deque; for both max and min, use two.

followUps.qZh: 为什么用两个单调队列？
followUps.qEn: Why two monotonic deques?
followUps.aZh: 窗口要随时知道最大值和最小值，删除左端元素时普通堆做不到 O(1)。递减队列的队首是最大值，递增队列的队首是最小值；过期元素到队首时弹出，每个元素进出各一次。
followUps.aEn: The window needs its maximum and minimum at all times, and a plain heap cannot drop the left element in O(1). A decreasing deque's front is the max and an increasing one's the min; expired fronts are popped, and each element enters and leaves once.

followUps.qZh: 用有序集合（TreeMap 或 multiset）可以吗？
followUps.qEn: Could an ordered multiset (TreeMap, multiset) do it?
followUps.aZh: 可以。窗口放进有序多重集合，取首尾就是最小值和最大值，O(n log n)，代码更短。
followUps.aEn: Yes. Keep the window in an ordered multiset and read its first and last elements: O(n log n) with shorter code.

lc-1456.takeawayZh: 定长窗口：进一个、出一个，只更新变化的那部分。
lc-1456.takeawayEn: Fixed-size window: one in, one out, update only what changed.

followUps.qZh: 要返回元音最多的那个窗口的位置？
followUps.qEn: Return where the best window is?
followUps.aZh: 更新最大值时记下窗口右端 r，答案是 [r − k + 1, r]；并列时保留第一个。
followUps.aEn: Record the right end r whenever the maximum improves; the window is [r − k + 1, r], keeping the first on ties.

followUps.qZh: 有很多次询问，每次 k 不同？
followUps.qEn: Many queries with different k?
followUps.aZh: 先算元音的前缀和，每个窗口的元音数是 P[i + k] − P[i]，每次询问 O(n)，不用重新统计。
followUps.aEn: Precompute prefix counts of vowels; each window is P[i + k] − P[i], so each query is O(n) with no recounting.

lc-1493.takeawayZh: 「必须删一个」= 窗口里最多一个 0，答案是窗口长度减 1。
lc-1493.takeawayEn: "Delete exactly one" means at most one 0 in the window, and the answer is its length minus 1.

followUps.qZh: 为什么全是 1 时答案是 n − 1？
followUps.qEn: Why is the answer n − 1 when everything is 1?
followUps.aZh: 必须删除一个元素，即使没有 0 也得删一个 1；「窗口长度减 1」的写法自然处理了这一点。
followUps.aEn: One element must be deleted even without zeros, so a 1 goes; "window length minus 1" already handles it.

followUps.qZh: 改成最多可以删 k 个 0？
followUps.qEn: What if up to k zeros may be deleted?
followUps.aZh: 窗口里最多 k 个 0。这时删除不是必须的，删完后全 1 的长度就是窗口里 1 的个数 = 窗口长度 − 窗口中 0 的个数。
followUps.aEn: Allow at most k zeros in the window. Deletion is now optional, and the run of ones left is the ones in the window: its length minus its zeros.

lc-1657.takeawayZh: 先看操作保留了什么不变量，判定条件就是「不变量相等」。
lc-1657.takeawayEn: Find what the operations preserve; the test is that those invariants match.

followUps.qZh: 为什么这两个条件就够了？
followUps.qEn: Why are these two conditions enough?
followUps.aZh: 操作 1 可以任意交换位置，所以顺序无关，只剩每个字符的次数。操作 2 可以任意调换「字符 → 次数」的对应，但不能引入新字符。所以字符集相同、次数的多重集相同，就能互相转换。
followUps.aEn: Operation 1 can reorder freely, so only counts matter. Operation 2 can permute which character has which count but cannot introduce a new character. Equal character sets and equal count multisets are therefore enough.

followUps.qZh: 字符集很大（Unicode）时怎么做？
followUps.qEn: What if the alphabet is huge (Unicode)?
followUps.aZh: 计数用哈希表；字符集用集合比较；次数的多重集用排序后的次数列表，或者「次数 → 出现几次」的计数表比较。
followUps.aEn: Count with a hash map, compare the character sets as sets, and compare the count multisets as sorted lists or as count-of-counts maps.

lc-1658.takeawayZh: 两端删除 ↔ 中间保留：换个角度看，往往就变成标准的窗口问题。
lc-1658.takeawayEn: Removing from both ends is keeping a middle: seen that way, it is often a standard window problem.

followUps.qZh: 为什么换成「保留中间最长的一段」？
followUps.qEn: Why look for the longest middle to keep?
followUps.aZh: 从两端删掉的部分加起来是 x，等价于中间保留的连续一段和为 total − x。删得最少 = 留得最长；元素全为正，这一段可以用滑动窗口找。
followUps.aEn: What leaves from both ends sums to x, so the kept middle sums to total − x. Fewest removals means the longest middle, and with positive elements a sliding window finds it.

followUps.qZh: 如果数组里有负数？
followUps.qEn: What if the array has negatives?
followUps.aZh: 窗口失效。改用前缀和加哈希表：记下每个前缀和第一次出现的位置，找和为 total − x 的最长子数组。
followUps.aEn: The window breaks. Use prefix sums with a hash map of each prefix sum's first index to find the longest subarray summing to total − x.

lc-1679.takeawayZh: 配对计数：用哈希表记下「等着被配对」的值，来一个能配上的就消掉一个。
lc-1679.takeawayEn: Counting pairs: keep the values waiting for a partner in a hash map, and cancel one whenever a match arrives.

followUps.qZh: 为什么逐个贪心配对不会少配？
followUps.qEn: Why does greedy pairing never lose a pair?
followUps.aZh: 能不能配只取决于值。x 和 k − x 最多配 min(cnt[x], cnt[k − x]) 对（x = k − x 时是 ⌊cnt/2⌋），不同的值之间互不影响，所以怎么配结果都一样。
followUps.aEn: Pairing depends only on values: x and k − x make at most min(cnt[x], cnt[k − x]) pairs (⌊cnt/2⌋ when x = k − x), and different values never compete, so any order gives the same total.

followUps.qZh: 数组已经排好序时？
followUps.qEn: What if the array is sorted?
followUps.aZh: 左右双指针：和等于 k 时两边都收缩并计数，和小了左边前进，和大了右边后退，O(1) 额外空间。
followUps.aEn: Two pointers: on a sum equal to k, count and move both; move left when the sum is small and right when large, O(1) extra space.

lc-1750.takeawayZh: 两端同时收缩的题，循环条件和「指针交叉」时的处理最容易错，先拿全相同的串检查。
lc-1750.takeawayEn: When both ends shrink, the loop condition and the crossing case are where bugs hide; test with a string of one repeated character.

followUps.qZh: 全是同一个字符时为什么要特别小心？
followUps.qEn: Why be careful when every character is the same?
followUps.aZh: 前缀和后缀不能重叠。外层循环要求 l < r（至少剩两个字符才能各删一段），删除时指针可以越过对方；越过就说明全删光了，答案是 0。
followUps.aEn: The prefix and suffix may not overlap. The outer loop needs l < r (two characters to delete from), while the inner deletion may cross over; crossing means everything is gone and the answer is 0.

followUps.qZh: 为什么每次都删到最长不会更差？
followUps.qEn: Why is deleting the longest run each time never worse?
followUps.aZh: 只删一部分，剩下的同样字符还在两端，下一步仍然得删它们；一次删完不会影响之后能删什么。
followUps.aEn: Deleting part of a run leaves the same character at the ends to be deleted next anyway; taking it all at once never limits later deletions.

lc-1763.takeawayZh: 「坏字符」不可能出现在答案里，就以它为界把问题切开，分治求解。
lc-1763.takeawayEn: A bad character can never be in the answer, so split the problem around it and recurse.

followUps.qZh: 分治为什么正确，复杂度是多少？
followUps.qEn: Why is divide and conquer correct, and how fast is it?
followUps.aZh: 若某个字母在整个串里只以一种大小写出现，任何包含它的子串都不美好，所以它把串切成几段，答案只在某一段里。每深入一层，至少少一种字母，深度不超过 26，总共 O(26·n)。
followUps.aEn: If a letter appears in only one case across the string, no substring containing it is nice, so it splits the string and the answer lies within one piece. Each level loses at least one letter, so depth is at most 26 and the total O(26·n).

followUps.qZh: 有多个等长答案时返回哪个？
followUps.qEn: Which answer when several have the same length?
followUps.aZh: 返回最早出现的。分治时从左到右处理各段，只有严格更长才替换，就能保证这一点。
followUps.aEn: The earliest. Process the pieces left to right and replace only on a strictly longer one.

lc-1814.takeawayZh: 等式两边都含 i 和 j 的项时，先移项，把同一个下标的放在一边，再按键计数。
lc-1814.takeawayEn: When both sides mix terms in i and j, move terms so each side has one index, then count by key.

followUps.qZh: 为什么要取模？取模时要注意什么？
followUps.qEn: Why the modulus, and what to watch with it?
followUps.aZh: n = 10^5 且所有键都相同时，数对约有 5×10^9 个，题目要求对 10^9+7 取模。边累加边取模，Java 和 C++ 里累加用 long。
followUps.aEn: With n = 10^5 and one shared key there are about 5×10^9 pairs, so the answer is taken modulo 10^9+7. Reduce as you add, accumulating in a long in Java and C++.

followUps.qZh: 反转函数有什么坑？
followUps.qEn: What is the trap in rev?
followUps.aZh: 末尾的 0 反转后会消失，rev(120) = 21，所以不能按字符串直接比较；用整数逐位反转即可。
followUps.aEn: Trailing zeros disappear, rev(120) = 21, so string comparison is wrong; reverse digit by digit as an integer.

lc-1838.takeawayZh: 排序后，「把窗口全部变成最大值」的代价可以用长度和窗口和 O(1) 算出来。
lc-1838.takeawayEn: After sorting, the cost of raising a window to its maximum is computed in O(1) from its length and sum.

followUps.qZh: 为什么目标值一定是窗口里最大的那个数？
followUps.qEn: Why is the target always the window's maximum?
followUps.aZh: 只能加不能减。把一组数变成同一个值，选它们中最大的那个作为目标代价最小；选更大的只会多花操作次数。
followUps.aEn: Values can only increase. Raising a group to its own maximum is cheapest; any larger target costs more operations.

followUps.qZh: 代价会溢出吗？
followUps.qEn: Can the cost overflow?
followUps.aZh: 窗口代价 = 最大值 × 长度 − 窗口和，可以到 10^5 × 10^5 = 10^10，超过 32 位；Java 和 C++ 用 long。
followUps.aEn: The cost, maximum × length − sum, can reach 10^5 × 10^5 = 10^10, beyond 32 bits; use long in Java and C++.

lc-1930.takeawayZh: 去重计数时，先固定最外层，再把它放到最宽的位置。
lc-1930.takeawayEn: When counting distinct results, fix the outermost choice first and stretch it as wide as possible.

followUps.qZh: 为什么只看每个字母第一次和最后一次出现？
followUps.qEn: Why only the first and last occurrence of each letter?
followUps.aZh: 两端都是字母 c 时，把区间拉到最宽（第一次到最后一次），中间能选的字母最多；任何更窄的区间能组成的回文，这里都能组成。
followUps.aEn: With c at both ends, the widest span (first to last occurrence) offers the most middle letters; anything a narrower span can form, this one can too.

followUps.qZh: 改成长度为 5 的回文子序列个数（不去重）？
followUps.qEn: Count length-5 palindromic subsequences instead, with repeats?
followUps.aZh: 枚举中间位置，左边统计每种有序字符对出现的次数，右边同理；把左边的 (a, b) 和右边的 (b, a) 相乘累加，O(26²·n)，结果取模。
followUps.aEn: Fix the middle position; count each ordered letter pair on the left and on the right, and add left (a, b) times right (b, a): O(26²·n), modulo the given prime.

lc-2024.takeawayZh: 只有两种取值时，分别假设最后是哪一种，问题就变成「窗口里少数派的个数 ≤ k」。
lc-2024.takeawayEn: With two values, assume each final value in turn; the problem becomes "the minority in the window is at most k".

followUps.qZh: 为什么对 T 和 F 各算一次？
followUps.qEn: Why run once for T and once for F?
followUps.aZh: 最后连续的一段要么全是 T、要么全是 F。对「全变成 T」来说，窗口里 F 的个数就是要改的次数，反之亦然，两次取较大值。
followUps.aEn: The final run is all T or all F. For all T, the Fs in the window are the changes needed, and vice versa; take the larger of the two answers.

followUps.qZh: 能不能一次扫描？
followUps.qEn: Can one pass do it?
followUps.aZh: 可以用「窗口长度 − 窗口里较多那种的次数 ≤ k」作为条件，这正是替换后最长重复字符那道题在只有两种字符时的特例。
followUps.aEn: Use "window length minus the larger count is at most k"; it is the two-letter case of Longest Repeating Character Replacement.

lc-2090.takeawayZh: 先把「半径」换算成窗口长度 2k+1，再处理两端凑不满的位置。
lc-2090.takeawayEn: Turn the radius into a window of length 2k+1 first, then handle the positions near the ends that cannot fill it.

followUps.qZh: 窗口和会溢出吗？
followUps.qEn: Can the window sum overflow?
followUps.aZh: 会。窗口长度最多 2×10^5+1，每个值到 10^5，和约 2×10^10，超出 32 位；Java 和 C++ 用 long 累加。
followUps.aEn: Yes. The window can hold 2×10^5+1 values of up to 10^5, about 2×10^10, beyond 32 bits; accumulate in a long in Java and C++.

followUps.qZh: 改成窗口的中位数？
followUps.qEn: What about the window median?
followUps.aZh: 平均数能 O(1) 更新，中位数不行：要用两个堆（配合延迟删除）或有序集合维护窗口，每步 O(log k)。
followUps.aEn: An average updates in O(1); a median does not. Maintain the window with two heaps (with lazy deletion) or an ordered multiset, O(log k) per step.

lc-2131.takeawayZh: 把每个词当作一个「字符」：互为反转的成对使用，自对称的词多出一个可以放中心。
lc-2131.takeawayEn: Treat each word as a character: reversed pairs are used together, and one leftover symmetric word can be the centre.

followUps.qZh: 为什么最多只能放一个对称词在正中间？
followUps.qEn: Why at most one symmetric word in the middle?
followUps.aZh: 中心以外的词都要和镜像位置的词互为反转。"gg" 这样的词自己就是自己的反转，落单的那个只能放在正中间，而正中间只有一个位置。
followUps.aEn: Every word off-centre must mirror its partner. A word like "gg" mirrors itself, so an unpaired one can only sit in the middle, and there is one middle.

followUps.qZh: 改成单个字母、可以任意重排呢？
followUps.qEn: What if the pieces were single letters, freely rearranged?
followUps.aZh: 那就是按字符次数凑回文：成对的全用上，再加一个中心。
followUps.aEn: Then it is building a palindrome from letter counts: use every pair, plus one centre.

lc-2302.takeawayZh: 计数类窗口：对每个右端，合法的左端是一段连续区间，个数就是窗口长度。
